faqs.question: Is MBA at Maharishi Markandeshwar University better than Chandigarh University (CU)?
faqs.answer:
According to internet, Chandigarh University is better for an MBA Maharishi Markandeshwar University (MMU). This is because CU has industry links, offers industry-sponsored programs, and has special labs for different work. 
 However, MMU has better placement than CU. MMU also offers dual specialisation courses and is considered one of the top management colleges in North India.

college_info.intro:
Maharishi Markandeshwar University gives UG and PG courses in fields like Engineering, Management, Dental, Law, Agriculture, Medical, Science, etc. BTech, BSc, and MBA are among the most popular programmes offered at the university.

The BTech programme offered at the university covers core courses in the areas of Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics & Communication, Biotechnology, etc. The MBA programme offered by the MMU is a two-year programme. paragraphs: MMDU Mullana admission process 2025 is entrance-based as well as merit-based. Candidates can apply through both online and offline modes. Located in Ambala, Maharishi Markandeshwar University (MMDU) is Deemed to be a university (MMDU) and is accredited by NAAC.MMDU Mullanaoffers UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the fields of Medicine, Engineering, Management, Humanities, Science, Law, etc. Candidates can obtain admission to any programme at Maharishi Markandeshwar - Deemed to be University (MMDU Mullana) by fulfilling the eligibility criteria and securing valid scores in the JEE Mains, NEET-UG, GATE, MAT, CMAT, NEET-MDS, or in the qualifying examination.

Maharishi Markandeshwar University applications are closed now for admission to UG & PG courses. It offers more than 150 courses across several streams.The courses are designed to be delivered in full-time mode. Maharishi Markandeshwar (Deemed to be University) has a dedicated training and placement cell that conducts various types of skill development programmes. Maharishi Markandeshwar University fees include multiple components, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, training and placement fees, etc. There are a few components that are paid one-time, while some have to be paid semester-wise or annually, such as tuition fees.

Coming to affordability, It is among the causes of many students quitting college or their degree. Although the availability of student loans and scholarships has made education more affordable, qualifying for one of these loans or scholarships frequently comes with a set of requirements that must be met. Note: Candidates must note that this fee is sourced from the official website of the institute/university sanctioning body and is subject to change.

Maharishi Markandeshwar University invites a large number of students for admission to UG and PG courses, every year. The admissions are ongoing. Candidates can apply for admission to various courses in the academic session. In addition, the university may deem it necessary to provide instruction and research in the streams of vocation, knowledge, technology, and profession. Below is the step-by-step process for Maharishi Markandeshwar University admission:
Step 1: MMDU Mullana-Ambala Application Process 2025:Visit the official website of the university @MMDUmullana.org and apply on the admission portal

Step 2: Selection: The selectionprocess may vary from course to course at MMDU Ambala. Candidates must meet the required entrance examination score. In addition to the entrance exams, students need to clear Personal Interviews and Group Discussion rounds. For several courses, such as BA, MA, BCom, BBA, etc., passing the Class 12 exam alone becomes a qualifying criterion.

Step 3: Counselling:Maharishi Markandeshwar University will conduct counselling round for students who have valid scores in the qualifying examination and have been shortlisted in the merit list; they will be called out for the counselling session.
Step 4: Payment of fee:At the time of counselling process, candidates will have to pay the fee for their desired course.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good and worth joining.
reviews.review_text: Campus is so huge and surrounded by trees. Classrooms are good, and a 24x7 Wi-Fi facility is available. Hostel rooms are so good. Washrooms are clean. There is a Fifa-verified football ground, swimming pool, basketball court, tennis court, etc. Mess food is so good. Medical facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely crazy college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my Nano technology course is good with well equipped classrooms and labs. The hostel facilities are also good with comfortable cottages and a well stocked library. The mess serves good quality food and there's a clinic on campus with a certified doctor. The total cost of my course is 4.5 Lacs per annum, and the hostel fee is 2 Lacs per annum.

reviews.review_heading: A well all-rounded university great for personal and professional growth.
reviews.review_text: Everything is great. There is a great variety of food catering to all, including vegetarian and Jains. Facilities are modern and up to date. The taste is very good with a weekly change in the menu. Medical facilities are good. There are nearby restaurants and hospitals catering to needs that may arise any time.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements are available after course completion.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of our college are pretty good. The facilities available in our college include smart classrooms, sports facilities mainly related to indoor sports, and a medical room. The hostels have decent facilities, and the mess offers good quality food.

reviews.review_heading: It's a practical-based course curriculum with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is not very large but offers many facilities. There are sports grounds where we can play cricket, football, volleyball, tennis, etc. A medical room is available for treatment. CCTV cameras are installed in classrooms and labs. Cafeterias serve good-quality food.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is good.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides excellent infrastructure. Two students share a single room. Air-conditioners and two fans are available in the rooms. Wi-Fi is available. The quality of the food in the mess is excellent. They serve a variety of food. The library is good and huge. Many books are available. Labs are excellent.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied because of the difficulty of exams but our campus has good environment.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. Wi-Fi is enabled on campus. Air-conditioners are available in the hostel and college. Library is very good and classrooms are spacious. Around 200 students can sit comfortably in our classrooms. The food served in the mess is better. Medical facilities are also available. Games are conducted in this college.

reviews.review_heading: The amount of supplementary exam is too high, i.e. 5k.
reviews.review_text:
The classrooms are very neat and they can accommodate upto 100 students and in some classrooms upto 200.
The Physics and electrical labs have all equipments working and they are in good numbers. The hostel rooms are spacious and clean. The mess food is hygienic and tasty.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are excellent. Wi-Fi facilities are very good with a very good connection. The food served in the mess and canteen is very hygienic. A variety of food is served. The hospital is open 24X7. There are many sports, including basketball, cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, chess, pool, and table tennis. There are also two gyms open to all.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mahindra University.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. The classrooms are very spacious and are air-conditioned. The college has big lecture halls. The college hostels are well maintained and have a good environment. There are labs for the students as well. There is also a library which has all the necessary books required by students.

reviews.review_heading: This college provides excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The food served in the mess is excellent. Our college has all facilities that students would require like, basketball courts, football field, table tennis, gym, volleyball courts, snooker room, etc. It also provides the infrastructure for research and engineering for working on drones, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Mahindra university has the best hostels. It's worth the money. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is very good. The mess is thoroughly maintained. We also have a gym, basketball courts, volleyball court, cricket ground, badminton courts, tennis courts, and a big football ground. We also have a small clinic.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is average and our college is a good platform to perceive higher studies.
reviews.review_text: All courses in our college are provided with materials needed in the library, labs, Wi-Fi on campus, and dorms. We have a clinic for medical situations and ambulance in case of emergencies. The hostel room is shared by only 2 people with attached bathroom for girls and common washroom for boys. The food and security is very good. We have various indoor and outdoor sports such as football, tennis, cricket, badminton, volleyball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: This college is good if students could not make it to IITs.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good in this college. Mess is good and it is a way far better than any other hostels. It provides a library lawn and classes are very well maintained. Wi-Fi is not that well maintained but can be sufficient for a normal user. A lot of variety of e-books and offline books are also provided in the library.

reviews.review_heading: The college has really good infrastructure and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Mahindra University is very good compared to all the EAMCET colleges. The hostels are also kept clean and tidy. The food is average. Sports facilities and medical facilities are excellent. The classrooms and labs are well maintained.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee of Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee will cost approximate 1.5 Lacs at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies for a year including hostel and mess charges. There is an option for you to choose AC or non-AC rooms.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies under CUET?
overview_faqs.answer: No, Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies is not under CUET. CUET, which stands for Central Universities Common Entrance Test, is a national entrance test administered by the NTA for MCA/Msc programs, but it does not include Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies in its scope.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies approved?
overview_faqs.answer: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC). The university is also accredited by NAAC with A+ grade. Further, it has been conferred with 5-star rating for Teaching, Employability, Academic Development, Facilities, Social Responsibility, and Inclusiveness by the QS Rating System.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A solid college choice with updated labs, internship opportunities, and improved placement.

content.Placements: The highest package is of 55 LPA, and the lowest is 3-4 LPA and 70-75%of students got placed. Well-known companies participated in the placement drive like TCS, HCL, Capgemini, Cognizant, which offer top roles like software engineer, Web developer, Data analyst and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Our department provides well-maintained infrastructure and facilities to support academic and practical learning. There is also a sports arena where there is a coach of boxing, shooting and many sports instruments. Wi-fi is also available on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Manav Rachna campus placement review

content.Placements: The Civil Engineering Department at SET, MRIIRS, along with the CRC, provides strong placement support, offering nearly 95 percent placement for eligible students, and through technical guidance and interview preparation, they help students become industry-ready.
content.Infrastructure: The department offers good infrastructure, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped civil engineering labs, and an updated library with relevant books and journals. The hostels provide clean rooms and essential amenities, and the mess offers decent-quality food with a variety of options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Balanced learning environment with strong labs and good placement.

content.Placements: The placement rate at my campus is about 100 percent. The average package in the civil department is 4 LPA to 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Mega, Ultratech, etc. Around 100 percent of students got internships from any course. The top roles offered in my course are Structural Design Engineer, Site Engineer, and Highway Designer.
content.Infrastructure: MRIIRS has smart classrooms. The labs are quite well-equipped for civil engineering. Especially, we have labs like the survey lab, structure lab, concrete technology lab, soil mechanics lab, and fluid mechanics lab. There is a central library for both digital and physical resources.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of all facilities.

content.Placements: The placement cell is active and supportive. We get regular training sessions, aptitude practice, interview preparation, and soft-skill development. Many companies visit the campus, and students get good opportunities in both core and non-core sectors. Internships are also provided in the third, fifth, and final years, which really help in gaining experience.
content.Infrastructure: MRIIRS has very good infrastructure. The classrooms are clean and air-conditioned. Labs are well-equipped, and the library has a great study environment. Civil Engineering labs like Surveying, Concrete Technology, Environmental, Geotechnical, and Structures are modern and provide hands-on learning. The campus is green, well-maintained, and has strong Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and good canteens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfying because of the many facilities and the faculty.

content.Placements: Almost 60 to 70% of students got placed in my course, and the highest package till now is 12 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. There are many top recruiting companies for my course, and almost 90% of students got internships from our course in many companies. The top role offered in our course is in big research and future bio projects.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure and facilities, as they provide us with free Wi-Fi, have AC in every classroom, and have 3 big libraries where any student can go and study. The labs are also very good, as they have the latest machines and a good environment.

admission_overview.college_name: MRIIRS Faridabad Admission 2025: Admissions and Eligibility

paragraphs: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studiesadmits students based on various national-level entrance exams such as JEE Mains 2025/ SAT / Pearson / MRNAT 2025, CUET, XAT, CAT etc. The mode of application at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is online.

The institute offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Business and Management Studies, Accounting, and Commerce among others. Popular courses offered by the university are MCA, BCA, MBA, BTech and BBA. MRIIRS Faridabad also offers multiple scholarships to support meritorious students and provide financial aid. Read on to know more aboutManav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies course admissions2025.

The university offers courses in full-time mode over 20 courses. MRIIRS Faridabad offers more than 20 courses across various specialisations and aspirants need to apply for courses through the official website. The admission process in 2025 is divided into five steps. Students can check the detailed points mentioned below:
Step One: Submission of Online Application
Visit the official website which is https://manavrachna.edu.in/mriirs
Step Two: Uploading Documents

Aspirants need to upload a Class 12 mark sheet, a Valid Score of JEE Mains/ GATE, SAT/UNIGAUGE (if appeared), a Valid score of CLAT, Pre-final Year Mark sheets of higher education qualification (For PG Program).
Step Three: Selection of Candidate and Offer of Admission Letter

Merit Defining Document: Admission to various programs is based on merit as specified in Admission Brochure. Admissions to all programs are also made based on Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for which the scores shall automatically be picked up for merit.
Step Four: Accepted of Admission and Payment of Fee

All the selected candidates for admission at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies, who receive Admission Offer Letter from the University shall be required to send the Acceptance of Admission for the offered programme in the format which shall be sent by the University Authority along with the Admission Offer Letter.

Thereafter, the candidate shall be required to deposit the first installment of fee for various programmes within one week of offer of admission by using any mode as mentioned below (after Step-five).
Step Five: Physical Verification of Documents and Enrollment Process

All the candidates, who have accepted the admission after receipt of Admission Offer Letter, shall be required to report at designated venue’s for “Physical Document Verification / Enrollment Process” as per the slots are given to them. Aspirants are required to bring Letter of ‘Offer of Admission’ and all the original fee receipts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Go for off-campus placements or go for higher education, not expect more from on-campus placements.

content.Placements: Generally, with the last trends, approximately 30% of students got placed. Top role offered in this course is data analytics. According to my information, the highest package is 12 LPA. The average salary ranges from 4 LPA - 4.5 LPA, and the lowest salary is 2.4 LPA. This depends from student to student and some students try to prepare for GATE exam and some of them go for internships.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel infrastructure is good. Facilities are good like Wi-Fi and reading room in hostel and personal study table provided to students. Mess food is also okay at a very minimal fee. But is very difficult to get a hostel in the first year if your percentage is less than 80%. If you are local then hostel chances are very low in the first year.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Nice college for Muslim students.

content.Placements: The total percentage of students placed in my college is 77%. The highest package is 8 LPA. The lowest package is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Brudco, and Britco. The percentage of students who got internships from my college is 80% in Britco and Bridco.
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi, good labs, nice classrooms, and good laboratories. The hostel facility is awesome. Campus life is very disgusting. There is a very nice hostel infrastructure. The people of this university are awesome. Teachers and non-teaching staff are also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The good environment of my university. It feels like the university and infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: Almost 70% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered ranges between 12 LPA - 15 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA - 5 LPA. The average package offered is 7 LPA - 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, Microsoft, and Deloitte. 60% of students secured internships at Microsoft, Infosys, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, analyst, consultant, and developed.
content.Infrastructure: Our department has well-equipped labs, Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, a vast library, and research space. The hostel offers clean rooms, good Wi-Fi, and basic amenities. The mess serves decent food. The canteen has multiple options. Medical facilities are available, along with sports grounds and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college has absolutely perfect faculty to study.

content.Placements: If I talk about placements then I will say that the placement in this university is just okay. In the previous batch, all the students are placed but the package is low. The highest package that I heard was 32 LPA and the lowest package was 4 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not fabulous but it is well. The university area has a Wi-Fi connection which gives speeds up to 1 Gbps but has some restrictions like you can not use this network for some applications and websites. There are 100% hostels for girls and 4 hostels for boys which are not sufficient. Therefore some of the freshers have to stay outside the university which is very costly but these students get a hostel the next year. The food quality is also good. The college has 2 canteens and 1 help center with free medicine. The college has an indoor stadium and a playground is also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college has an islamic mahol with better studies.

content.Placements: About 50% of students got placed in our college. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The top recruiting company is TCS. Almost 40% of students got internships. The top role offered is web developer.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is very good. The mess food is reasonable and well-hygiene. They maintain hot and cold water for bathing purposes. Washrooms are clean and well-maintained. Sports facilities are also good. A big gym is also available. Medical facilities are top-notch and good.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Agartala Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is overall good. If you get better branch only then join it. Otherwise don't.

content.Placements: About 80 percent students from my branch got placed. The highest package from NIT Agartala is 52 LPA and average package is just 8 LPA. Those who have connection with seniors will only get placement. Not everyone. Almost all branches are available here.
content.Infrastructure: As my branch is Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, I have to study in the same building as CSE branch building. Infrastructure of classroom, labs and library are good. With AC in library, but only problem is Wi-Fi. Sometimes we are able to use Wi-Fi. Sometimes can't.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and one of the most beautiful NITs.

content.Placements: The placements for the year 2025 to 26 are very good and satisfying. The campus placement is happening all year round for final year students. Placements are much better for CSE and circuit branches compared to the core branches. Approximately 80 percent of eligible students get placed every year by different companies such as Google, Amazon, Oracle, PayPal, JSW, Sigmoid etc. The average placement for CSE is about 11 LPA and for core branches is about 8 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is very good. Facilities provided here are Wi-Fi, water, and a lift all of which are very good except the mess for the first year, but it also becomes good as you enter the second year. There is a huge sports complex with all the facilities like a basketball court, badminton court, table tennis, gym, swimming pool, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: About NIT, how it will be.

content.Placements: About placement, around 80 to 85% students get placed every year. The highest package was about 48 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA. The recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, etc. There are many internships also on the campus; you can get one by giving an interview.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college was very good. The campus had fast Wi-Fi and many grounds and sports rooms. There were many different types of departments on the campus. The quality of the hostel was also good, and in the canteen, the food quality was okay, but it could be improved.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The best college across India for placement and college life.

content.Placements: Around 85-90 percent of students get placed every year. The highest package was about 50 LPA, and the lowest package was around 3 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Amazon, Google, PayPal, Microsoft, etc. The top roles offered were software engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities were excellent in every department. We had multiple labs, fast Wi-Fi, and a big library. Hostel facilities were also good. We had big grounds for different sports and games. The food quality was also good, but it could be improved.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Best engineering college.

content.Placements: Placements are good enough if your skills are much better than those of others. If your CG is at least above 8.5, then you will definitely get a good package. Many companies come to our college, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, etc. The highest package last year was 68 LPA. There were many opportunities for internships if you had good skills compared to other students and also had a decent CG of at least above 8.5. Microsoft also came last year and picked two girls from an idea in Agartala.
content.Infrastructure: There is a big library on the campus with enough books for every subject, and literature and novels are also available. Classrooms depend on the building in which your classes are held. Science block classes are not very good, but in the CSE and the new freshers’ building started this year, the classrooms are very good. There are a lot of clubs. In the hostel, there are two beds in a room with double accommodation, tube lights, and fans. The food is average, but the quality is good.

paragraphs: Find below the complete process aroundNIT Agartala admission 2025:
NIT Agartala Application Process

Students seeking admission at NIT Agartala are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. Students have toapplyfor the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to MBA, MA and PhD courses must are required to apply through the official website.
Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Agartala admits students with a validJEE Mainscore. Seats are alloted through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Agartala MBA admissions are done through MAT, CAT, and CMAT scores, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Agartala cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respectivecounsellingbodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

NIT Agartala fees for all UG & PG courses include components such as tuition fees, hostel fees and one-time fee payments. Similarly, a total of 2,000+ seats are available for overall courses. reviews.review_heading: College is overall good. If you get better branch only then join it. Otherwise don't.
reviews.review_text: As my branch is Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering, I have to study in the same building as CSE branch building. Infrastructure of classroom, labs and library are good. With AC in library, but only problem is Wi-Fi. Sometimes we are able to use Wi-Fi. Sometimes can't.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and one of the most beautiful NITs.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is very good. Facilities provided here are Wi-Fi, water, and a lift all of which are very good except the mess for the first year, but it also becomes good as you enter the second year. There is a huge sports complex with all the facilities like a basketball court, badminton court, table tennis, gym, swimming pool, etc.

reviews.review_heading: About NIT, how it will be.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was very good. The campus had fast Wi-Fi and many grounds and sports rooms. There were many different types of departments on the campus. The quality of the hostel was also good, and in the canteen, the food quality was okay, but it could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: The best college across India for placement and college life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities were excellent in every department. We had multiple labs, fast Wi-Fi, and a big library. Hostel facilities were also good. We had big grounds for different sports and games. The food quality was also good, but it could be improved.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college.
reviews.review_text: There is a big library on the campus with enough books for every subject, and literature and novels are also available. Classrooms depend on the building in which your classes are held. Science block classes are not very good, but in the CSE and the new freshers’ building started this year, the classrooms are very good. There are a lot of clubs. In the hostel, there are two beds in a room with double accommodation, tube lights, and fans. The food is average, but the quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: First qualify, then dream about this college.
reviews.review_text: There is a big library on the campus with enough books for every subject, and literature and novels are also available. Classrooms depend on the building in which your classes are going on, like science block classes are not good, but in the CSE and a new freshers building, which was started this year, for the first year, we are having very good classes. Here are a lot of clubs. In the hostel, there are two beds in a room as this is double accommodation, tubelights, fan, covered, food is average...

reviews.review_heading: Prasenjit Das college review.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course were so good. Wi-Fi and classroom were available in my college. The quality of food in college canteen was so superb. Medical facility was not good. All sports and games were available for all students in my course.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Agartala is getting better, but due to its locality, its development will take time.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of NIT Agartala is good. Wi-Fi is available everywhere with a daily 2 GB Jionet. Classrooms are also cleaned with daily washing. Libraries are also big with the maximum number of books available. The quality of facilities in the hostel is not that good. The food quality is not good. Canteen's food is also not good. Medical facilities are average. Sports exposure is below average, with vast sporting games played here.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, placement is not that good, really, infrastructure and facilities are very good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my college is good, the classrooms are good, the labs are also very good, and there are many things in the labs. The Wi-Fi facility of my college is very fast, but the quality of the mess food is not good. The food is too oily. There is a hospital in our college, which is open 24 hours. The sports section is very good, every game is there as per your wish, and you can participate.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. You should take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: NIT Agartala occupies around 365 acres of campus, set in a serene environment with well-planned academic blocks and greenery. The institute offers modern classrooms, seminar halls, and a lecture theatre equipped with projectors and other audiovisual aids. Labs are well-equipped across departments, including computer labs, electronics, mechanical, civil, etc., supporting hands-on learning. The central library has a large collection (several tens of thousands of books), many journals (200), plus d...

reviews.review_heading: About good placements (75%) with good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In hostel room, 2 students share a single room. In room, two beds, two tube lights, one ceiling fan, one table, one chair, and one almirah are available. Mess food is average. Three times a week give chicken, two times egg at night. Classrooms are cleaned. Library is quite big and books are available.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, but the hostel and mess food are problematic.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are average, and the food is also not that good. Wi-Fi here is bad, too. Canteen, we have a Nescafe, but there are only a few items available. Classrooms are of average quality. Lawns are pretty good too, and medical facilities are active 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, as it is NIT. Hostels are well-maintained, and the mess food is good. First-year students stay in the RNT hostel. We also have a hospital also in our campus. We have a very large sports complex. There are lots of mess and canteens available all over the campus.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Agartala College Review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was practical, with good facilities both for sports and academics. You could always use a LAN port for an unlimited public Ethernet connection. The campus was full of well organized events, and the different clubs add to the diversity and opportunities for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall great college and nice campus.
reviews.review_text: Good and clean hostels are there. Our college has good atmosphere and very nice to spend time here. The courses are very great. There are 10 different branches that offer you to learn deep engineering. Very good and nice campus as well. I recommend taking admission to this college.

reviews_list.review_title: The college is good having a reputation all across India, but it is in a remote area.

review_content.Placements: 50 precent of the students got placed in my branch. The highest package offered is 14 LPA in the electrical branch with the lowest package of 5 lakh by TCS. Top recruiting companies are Vedanta ,L&T ,Tata, Power Grid and many other companies. I have done my internships in Power Grid and BHEL.
review_content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are of good size. There are two types of classes, one normal having a capacity of 40 students and the other is a lecture hall which has a capacity of 150 students. Every class has a projector. Labs are equipped with latest equipments. The entire campus is wifi enabled. The hostel facilities are good with one room being shared between 3 students. The hostel food is really delicious.

review_content.Placements: As of now, around 40% of the students got placed in my batch. Among those, the highest package is 9 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. The top recruiter is L&T. Placement drives are still going on, and we expect better ones in the second half. In our senior batch, almost each student got 2–3 jobs.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of academic buildings is not bad. But you will be disappointed if you place high hopes on infrastructure. In hostels, we get almost all the facilities. The only things that concern us are power cuts and connectivity. Only BSNL works there so to use the internet, we need to depend solely on Wi-Fi.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Arunachal Pradesh Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of the language barrier, and the infrastructure needs to be developed.

content.Placements: Almost every student gets placed in our Mechanical branch. The highest package is 40 LPA, the average is 20 LPA, and the lowest is 15 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are L&T and Bridge & Roof. Around 90% of students get internships in the Steel Plant.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in our department include Wi-Fi, labs, digital classrooms, a library, and a workshop. The hostel provides basic needs and maintains the mess well. Equal priority is given to sports and games on our campus to ensure overall growth.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college from a studies perspective and good placements.

content.Placements: About 70% of students get placed. The highest package is 32 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 11.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies that visit the college are Microsoft and LNT. B. Tech in computer science, ECE, mechanical, and civil are provided.
content.Infrastructure: The major setback of this college besides placement is the infrastructure of this college. The infrastructure is below average. The transportation is a little bit difficult. Classrooms are decent. The library has some issues and labs are okay. Wi-Fi is fast but it fluctuates frequently. The hostel rooms are very good, and the quality of the food is also good. The canteen provides a decent variety of food items. Medical facilities are also good but sports facilities are not so good. The football ground is under construction.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college is good having a reputation all across India, but it is in a remote area.

content.Placements: 50 precent of the students got placed in my branch. The highest package offered is 14 LPA in the electrical branch with the lowest package of 5 lakh by TCS. Top recruiting companies are Vedanta ,L&T ,Tata, Power Grid and many other companies. I have done my internships in Power Grid and BHEL.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are of good size. There are two types of classes, one normal having a capacity of 40 students and the other is a lecture hall which has a capacity of 150 students. Every class has a projector. Labs are equipped with latest equipments. The entire campus is wifi enabled. The hostel facilities are good with one room being shared between 3 students. The hostel food is really delicious.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Fulfilled expectations: A critical evaluation of NIT Arunachal Pradesh.

content.Placements: As of now, around 40% of the students got placed in my batch. Among those, the highest package is 9 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. The top recruiter is L&T. Placement drives are still going on, and we expect better ones in the second half. In our senior batch, almost each student got 2–3 jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of academic buildings is not bad. But you will be disappointed if you place high hopes on infrastructure. In hostels, we get almost all the facilities. The only things that concern us are power cuts and connectivity. Only BSNL works there so to use the internet, we need to depend solely on Wi-Fi.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure and faculty is not as par as other NIT's.

content.Placements: Generally in my course in my college only 1/3 get placed. The highest package goes around 16 LPA and the lowest package is around 6lpa. Top companies recruiting are BHEL, Deolite, etc. In my course harfly anyone gets internship in companies they generally do in IIT's.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very bad in our college. Wi-Fi is not available most of the times. There is even no library our campus. There is no proper sports field here, no coach, no training staff are present. Mess and canteen food is good but they ch high as students rely on them as hostel food is not so good.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average but improving. LAN facility will be provided within a few months. There is a decent library in this college. Mess is average.

reviews.review_text: Our college provides us with all facilities. The hostel facilities are average. Around 3 students can stay in each room. Wi-Fi is being provided in a hostel and the campus. review_summary.college_name: NIT Goa Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: NIT Goa has shifted to the new campus.

content.Placements: Last year and the year before the placements were not that high but generally a lot of companies visit our college for placements and hire a good number of students. In 2022, the campus placements for CSE, ECE, and EEE were almost 100%. Almost all students got internships but it is generally off-campus.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Goa has shifted to the new campus in 2023. So everything is new and it has fresh infrastructure. We have a 2-floor library, one with books and one as a study hall. Lab equipment and classrooms are brand new. I would rate 2.5 out of 5 for the quality of mess food. Medical facilities are great. We have a separate building for it and a 24x7 ambulance near hostels. We have a very big ground for games. We have a basketball ground and a volleyball court. Inside the hostel, we have a badminton court.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: NIT GOA's genuine review.

content.Placements: Placement scenes in NIT Goa are average. The highest package in NIT Goa is 44 LPA, while the average package is around 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ORACLE, TCS, and NSE. 100% of students who appear for placements get placed, while some opt for off-campus placement too.
content.Infrastructure: As our college is newly built in January 2024, so infrastructure is top-notch. We have more than enough Wi-Fi routers right in front of our room and in every building. We have all types of labs for all branches of students, and we have a proper library having all books that are required. The best part is single rooms in hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: National Institute of Technology, Goa is one of the emerging NIT.

content.Placements: Normally 80 to 90 percent of circuital branch students are placed. The lowest package is around 6 LPA, with the average being 11 LPA. The highest package was 23 LPA this year and 44 LPA the previous year. Companies like Samsung, Infosys, Accenture, and various PSUs come. The roles offered for my course are mostly software developers, as many students prepare for that. Other than that, roles like VLSI engineers are also offered.
content.Infrastructure: After switching to the new permanent campus, the infrastructure is top-notch. We have a huge library, department blocks, teaching block, ground, etc. The mess is within hostels. The only drawback is the boys hostel is around a km away from the teaching block, although it's within campus. Therefore, having a bicycle is recommended.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: NITG is definitely one of the developing NITs, as it now has its own new campus.

content.Placements: NIT Goa has good placements, and in the branch Civil, it also has good placements. Students got average packages of 13 LPA. Government companies & MNCs do come here for placement. It has good placement of cells, which is very good. All you need is skills. If you have good skills, you will get placed .
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is so good as we shifted to our new campus. So everything on the new campus is new & good. Canteen, medical facility, etc.—everything is good. Faculty members will help you in everything. Also, you will get single rooms from the first year in this NIT, which is a very good thing.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good experience, good faculty for core branches and good placement records.

content.Placements: Around 95% of students were placed in good companies like Amazon, NSE, Oracle, Samsung, Intel, etc. with an average package of 15–16 LPA. The highest package offered was 44 LPA by Amazon. Meanwhile, the lowest package offered to 6 LPAs by L&T was the management post. Currently, the institute has tie-ups with NIO and Persistent Technologies, which offer internship programs to students.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel's condition is decent. Wi-Fi, due to being BSNL, fluctuates a lot but is decent whenever required. But if the network goes down, it takes a lot of time to bring it up. This makes it difficult for the students to sometimes complete their assignments.

reviews.review_text: NIT Goa has shifted to the new campus in 2023. So everything is new and it has fresh infrastructure. We have a 2-floor library, one with books and one as a study hall. We have a very big ground for games. We have a basketball ground and a volleyball court. Inside the hostel, we have a badminton cour...

reviews.review_heading: NIT GOA's genuine review.
reviews.review_text:
As our college is newly built in January 2024, so infrastructure is top-notch. We have more than enough Wi-Fi routers right in front of our room and in every building. We have all types of labs for all branches of students, and we have a proper library having all books that are required.
The best part is single rooms in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Goa is one of the emerging NIT.
reviews.review_text: After switching to the new permanent campus, the infrastructure is top-notch. We have a huge library, department blocks, teaching block, ground, etc. The mess is within hostels. The only drawback is the boys hostel is around a km away from the teaching block, although it's within campus. Therefore, having a bicycle is recommended.

reviews.review_heading: NITG is definitely one of the developing NITs, as it now has its own new campus.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is so good as we shifted to our new campus. So everything on the new campus is new & good.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience, good faculty for core branches and good placement records.

Things are going to improve as we shift to the new campus starting this semester.

overview_faqs.question: What is unique about NIT Mizoram?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Mizoram is one of the newly established NITs in 2010. The best part about this university is it's scenic location. It's new establishment does not get in the way of its academic expertise. Being located in one of the most educated states of our country with a literacy rate of 91%, the university offers a wide range of BTech M.Tech and PhD courses in the field of engineering. Even though the university does not have a permanent campus yet the infrastructure including the classrooms, laboratories are very well-equipped for student's hands-on learning and research purpose. The university offers excellent placements through the top recruiting companies giving a high salary package to at least 60% of the students.The flagship course offered by the university is BTech computer Science engineering. All the expiring engineering students can definitely count on NIT Mizoram.

overview_faqs.question: Is it worth joining NIT Mizoram?
overview_faqs.answer: As per the data collated from verified students' reviews published on Shiksha, students of NIT Mizoram have received placement opportunities from companies, such as Amazon, Flipkart, TCS and Wipro, among others. While the students in their reviews mention that 40-100% of students get placement opportunities every year under different BTech specialisations, the NIRF report of 2022 provides data that only 30% of students (30 out of 97) got placed via the campus. Additionally, the median package stood at INR 6.80 LPA. Hence, keeping the NIT tag in mind and medium-level placement opportunities at a location far away from metro cities, NIT Mizoram can be considered a decent option for education. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A college with beautiful scenery and peaceful life.

content.Placements: Since it's a third-tier college, it doesn't have many valuable placements. As it's a nationally recognised institute, top students get around above 12 LPA, while students with average grades just pass by 6 LPA-8 LPA. There are not many reputed companies coming to this college. If you have skills/talent and want to take your college life peacefully with a little more effort made in JEE preparation, then this is a good college for you.
content.Infrastructure: So about the hostel, first of all, the view from the balcony is the best, trust me, you will not be disappointed. Rooms are pretty much spacious. Just the food and water supply are the main problems, food is edible, it's not that bad, though. Water is supplied by trucks or tempos to the hostel. Electricity is almost 24/7. Wi-Fi speed is decent, but one may face problems with it on particular floors. Hostels are divided into 4 parts. Hostel 3 is for all first-year boys, while hostels 1 and 2 are combined for the rest of the year boys. There are only 2 girls' hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: NIT Mizoram review: peaceful campus and growing opportunities.

content.Placements: Placement of NIT Mizoram is good. 80 to 90% of students are placed. The average package is 8 LPA, and many companies are visiting the campus like Wipro, TCS, Infosys, etc. This year, one student got an internship at Nvidia. Placement is improving year by year, and on-campus internships are being provided by companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at NIT Mizoram is decent and improving year by year. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and laboratories are adequately equipped for regular academic work. The library has sufficient books for students. Hostel facilities are basic but comfortable, with regular water and electricity supply. Wi-Fi is available but not working properly. The mess food quality is average and manageable. The campus is peaceful, safe, and surrounded by natural beauty, which provides a good environment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A rapidly improving new gen NIT in Northeast India.

content.Placements: I can tell the placement happened here, and also good kind of placement. But it is limited to few companies and little to no tech giants. The placement percentage is exceptionally good. We just have to work really hard here because there is certainty that we will be placed but package depends on our hardwork.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel and its facilities are actually really good ofcourse it's an NIT but sometimes water issues are there. Some people may not like the food on some days of week. We have a restaurant down the hostel so hostel life is good. Doctor is available 24X7, and medical facility is actually free. There is a little Wi-Fi issue in hostel but in college it works really fine.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: How life goes in NIT Mizoram.

content.Placements: Last year, more than 90 percent of students were placed. Right now, the highest package is 21 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and the average package is 9 LPA. Our top recruiting companies are Juspay, Vedanta, Adani Wilmar, etc. Many of our students get internships in companies and colleges like BIS, NTPC, NITs, and IITs.
content.Infrastructure: To be honest, our college doesn't have a campus, but we have proper labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a library. Hostel facilities are good, with good maintenance. Geysers, fans, and beds are provided by the college. The food quality is good, but the taste is average. There is a medical help center that every student can access. Our college also encourages students to participate in sports events like Inter NITs and conducts a sports fest every year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has a good academic environment and a growing infrastructure.

content.Placements: I am currently pursuing B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing. Students get placed in my course. The highest package is 46 LPA, and the lowest package is 9.7 LPA. The average package is 15.3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: There are separate hostels for both boys and girls with good security and 24x7 Wi-Fi. It has clean and spacious rooms either single or shared with necessary furniture. The water environment is peaceful, making it ideal for students. The mess is also good. It has high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity across the campus.
content.Other: The campus has a diverse student community from different states of India. It has supportive faculty members and seniors who help juniors in academics and projects.

Step 2: Selection Rounds

paragraphs: The highest package grabbed by students during NIT Mizoram placement 2025 stood at INR 35 LPA . The overall placement rate recorded was 93.1%. Further, the placement percentage recorded for CSE, EE, ECE, CE and ME branch stood at 97%, 93%, 89%, 93% and 93%, respectively.

NIT Mizoram has a placement Cell responsible for securing attractive career opportunities for students. The institute invites companies from different sectors to conduct the placement process at the Campus premises. The placed students also get the opportunity to do their final project in the placed company as an intern with a stipend at this phase. After successful completion of the internship, the students can get full-time employment. The NIT placement depends on various factors such as the brand value of the institute, industry demand, skills of the students, etc.

Earlier, NIT Mizoram concluded the placements for the batch passed out in 2024 with 86% placement rate . As per the latest report, the highest and average package offered during NIT Mizoram placements 2024 stood at INR 14.5 LPA and INR 7.02 LPA, respectively. A total of 75 students registered for the NIT Mizoram placements 2024, of which 75 students were placed in reputed companies. Additionally, 100% of the CE, ME and EEE branch students were placed in 2024, whereas 63% of the CSE and 80% of the ECE branch students were placed in top companies . The top recruiters of NIT Mizoram in 2024 included Deloitte, Tech Mahindra, L&T, Adobe, KEC, Ashoka Leyland, Alston, Vedanta , etc.

Just the food and water supply are the main problems, food is edible, it's not that bad, though. Water is supplied by trucks or tempos to the hostel. Electricity is almost 24/7. Wi-Fi speed is decent, but one may face problems with it on particular floors. Hostels are divided into 4 parts. Hostel 3 is for all first-year boys, while hostels 1 and 2 are ...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Mizoram review: peaceful campus and growing opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at NIT Mizoram is decent and improving year by year. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained, and laboratories are adequately equipped for regular academic work. The library has sufficient books for students. Hostel facilities are basic but comfortable, with regular water and electricity supply. Wi-Fi is available but not working properly. The mess food quality is average and manageable. The campus is peaceful, safe, and surrounded by natural beauty, which provides a good env...

reviews.review_heading: A rapidly improving new gen NIT in Northeast India.
reviews.review_text: Hostel and its facilities are actually really good ofcourse it's an NIT but sometimes water issues are there. Some people may not like the food on some days of week. We have a restaurant down the hostel so hostel life is good. Doctor is available 24X7, and medical facility is actually free. There is a little Wi-Fi issue in hostel but in college it works really fine.

reviews.review_heading: How life goes in NIT Mizoram.
reviews.review_text: To be honest, our college doesn't have a campus, but we have proper labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a library. Hostel facilities are good, with good maintenance. Geysers, fans, and beds are provided by the college. The food quality is good, but the taste is average. There is a medical help center that every student can access. Our college also encourages students to participate in sports events like Inter NITs and conducts a sports fest every year.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good academic environment and a growing infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There are separate hostels for both boys and girls with good security and 24x7 Wi-Fi. It has clean and spacious rooms either single or shared with necessary furniture. The water environment is peaceful, making it ideal for students. The mess is also good. It has high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity across the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, National Institute of Technology is a good college for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Extracurricular activities at NIT Mizoram have a vibrant student life. There are many clubs and organizations that students can join. These clubs organize a variety of events, including cultural events, technical events, and sports events. Students can also participate in various competitions and workshops.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: College does not have a permanent campus. However, there are different blocks for different departments. Each block consists of Wi-Fi for students. There is a central library as well. Classrooms have smartboards. There is a medical professional available at the college as well. Buses are provided for students to pick and drop them from college to hostel and vice versa. Mess is also available where breakfast, lunch, and dinner are served.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college to consider if you are not getting other good colleges. Just go for it.
reviews.review_text: NIT Mizoram doesn't have it's permanent campus for now. We do feel its consequences. Different blocks are a bit far away so you have to travel quite changing blocks. This is the major lag of this college. Talking about classrooms, the size is small and not well-equipped even just feels like average sitting there. Labs are good and well-equipped. Professors guide us nicely there. Hostels are average. You will get basic facilities of course. But didn't expect much. The mess is average. We can surv...

reviews.review_heading: BASED ON NIT MIZORAM Review.
reviews.review_text: Lab, the classroom is okay. Ultimately, if you want to study, then no matter how the classroom is. And the hostel is good for girls and there are no sports activities for girls. But on sports day, you enjoy a little more. But if you want campus life, then it is not perfect for you.

reviews.review_heading: If you want NIT tag then come otherwise not.
reviews.review_text: It's not that good in infrastructure because NIT Mizoram has no permanent campus and no own building. There isn't even a temporary campus here. But if you want the NIT tag, then it's good. The hostel is not that good in terms of facilities, but for living purposes, you can adjust.

reviews.review_heading: One semester experience in NIT Mizoram
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure in NIT Mizoram is decent—not too bad, not too good. It is okay, but the Wi-Fi is slow, and the labs are good. However, the classrooms need work. The hostel facility is not good because sometimes we face a shortage of water.

reviews.review_heading: It has good teaching staff members and providing knowledge is the ultimate goal here.
reviews.review_text: The quality of food served is good. Bathrooms are not cleaned regularly. The ratio of bathrooms to students is 1:10 so they should clean bathrooms twice a week.

reviews.review_heading: Review of National Institute of Technology,  mizoram.
reviews.review_text: Since it is a hill area, network issues are there. But they provide Wi-Fi here, and sometimes Wi-Fi works slowly. Hostels are on the average side. Food is also not convincing, and since it is in the North, students can't even like food outside. Students don't get a homely feel.

reviews.review_heading: My review on NIT Mizoram.
reviews.review_text: Since it is a hill area, the network is not that good. They provide Wi-Fi, but sometimes the network is slow. The infrastructure is average since it is a hill area and a temporary campus. The food here in the North is not acceptable. Every day there are potatoes in the mess, and the food is not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Bad college, but good nature.
reviews.review_text: Very bad quality of food is available here in the mess. Wi-Fi is too slow in Aizawl; the network connection is very bad at times. The climate is also challenging here in Aizawl. Classrooms have no fans and are very uneasy to sit in. The library is quite large; we can get any type of book there, but we have to reenter it monthly. overview_faqs.question: Is NIT Nagaland good for MSc?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Nagaland is among the newly established NITs in the northeast region. It managed to secure 201-250 band under Engineering category. As for its placement, NIT Nagaland hasn't released the 2023 placement report. However, its previous year's placement was very decent. The the highest and mean package offered during NIT Nagaland placements 2022 stood at INR 45 LPA and INR 8.09 LPA, respectively. Further, the top recruiters during NIT Nagaland placements 2022 included TCS, Deloitte and Infosys. Apart from this, according to NIT Nagaland NIRF report 2023, the median package offered during NIT Nagaland BTech and MTech placements 2022 stood at INR 9 LPA and INR 10.05 LPA, respectively.

overview_faqs.question: How is NIT Nagaland campus?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Nagaland is based in Dimapur, Nagaland. It has a sturdy infrastructure that provide access to a central library and clean classrooms and labs. The overall infrastructure is great. The hostel for boys and girls are seperate and the main building is close to them. There are immense facilities for sports in the campus with indoor activities including Table Tennis, badminton, chess and carrom for rejuvenation. The outdoor games include football and cricket. Students also have access to digital library. There is also a provision for ATM and medical facilities in the campus.

paragraphs: NIT Nagaland admission process consists of application, selection, counselling, followed by subsequent admission confirmation. NIT admission is completely entrance-based and depends on valid JEE Main ranks. Interested candidates can follow the steps below to complete the NIT Nagaland admission process:
Qualify for JEE Main, GATE, and IIT JAM

Interested candidates in taking admission to BTech course are required to appear for the JEE Main exam. For MTech and MSc, the accepting exams are GATE and IIT JAM, respectively. JEE Main exams are conducted in two phases starting from January to March. GATE usually conducts the exam in January. IIT JAM exams are held in the month of February.
Apply for JoSAA/ CSAB/CCMT/CCMN counselling

Students with a valid JEE Mains and GATE score are eligible to apply through JoSAA/CCMN/CCMT. Applicants must go to the JoSAA official website to register themselves. They must select NIT Nagaland as their preferred institute. Also, for MTech and MSc course admission, students are required to visit the CCMT/CCMN official website to register. For PhD, candidates must apply via the NIT Nagaland's official website.
Seat Allocation

On the basis ofNIT Nagaland cutoff, JoSAA will allocate seats according to the candidate's JEE Main score. Seats for MTech and MSc courses will be allocated based on CCMT/CCMN, respectively. Further, NIT Nagaland will release a list of shortlisted students for PhD admission. Leftover seats will be filled in through the Institute Entrance Examination after CCMN counselling.
Seat finalisation
After the seats confirmation, candidates can pay the tuition fee at institutes' official website.

The fee structure might include other components, such as tuition fees, hostel fees, medical insurance, mess, etc. Other components can be paid semester-wise. Students can expect a decent ROI at the institute. The institute has a wide range of fees for its various programmes, ranging from45,000 to 5 lakh. reviews.review_heading: Great college with good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Our college has best infrastructure facilities. They contain Wi-Fi beautiful library and clean classrooms. The food in our hostel is really hygienic and healthy. Games period is also allotted in the timetable schedule. Food quality is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Pros and cons of the college.
reviews.review_text: College has secured good rankings and recognition from various top organisations. To relax and chill, various activities are performed in the college, some of which include dedicated rooms, fitness centres, and badminton courts. Hostel zones were peaceful but highly restrictive.

reviews.review_heading: Pros and cons of my campus.
reviews.review_text: To relax and chill, various activities are performed in the college, some of them include introducing dedicated rooms, fitness centers, and badminton courts. Hostel zones were peaceful but highly restrictive.

reviews.review_heading: Master of Science in Physics at Nagaland.
reviews.review_text: The campus area was hygienic, with all facilities looked at by students to pursue their courses. Student safety was a priority for the management over other activities. Transportation on the college campus was very good. All the necessary safety measures were initiated in the college

reviews.review_heading: Great college, Great crowd and awesome college life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facility is fast enough and is available in all of campus. You get like  upwards of 200-300mbps on laptops. On phones, it can vary between 35-120mbps. Classrooms are good enough to accommodate all of the students. Don’t expect modern classrooms. Classrooms are good but aren’t super modern or anything, though they get most of the work done. We have one cricket football ground, a badminton court, a cricket practice net, a volleyball court, and a basketball court. We are provided with table t...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities with a chill semester, enough time to pursue your interest.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good as compared to other North East College. Hostel is newly built. All hostels and campus are equipped with Wi-Fi. In the first year, your hostel will be just outside the campus. All the hostel rooms are double and triple-sharing and have enough space for 3 and 4 members. Lab facility of the college is very good. It has all the necessary equipment with good infrastructure. New departmental buildings are also under construction.

reviews.review_heading: This college is better than I expected.
reviews.review_text: The course is designed to be easier, making it accessible for students who may struggle academically, so everyone has a good chance of passing. This provides an advantage for scoring well and achieving a good CGPA. Hostels are in excellent condition with good infrastructure. Currently, first-year students are in a rented hostel off-campus due to availability issues, but a new hostel building is in progress. The hostels for second-, third, and fourth-year students are very nice.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college because of the college facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have got Wi-Fi in our hostels and admin buildings but the network connectivity is very bad overall around our college. We have got about 4-5 labs for first-year students which consist of physics lab, chemistry lab, etc. Few concrete classrooms with fans and about 5 bamboo classrooms with fans. A small library with a seating capacity of about 20 students but the availability of books is good. The food served in the mess is good.

reviews.review_heading: College campus is huge and placements are also good.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is good, and we have a library, student section, help desk, and many classrooms available in the main building. Also, we have an auditorium, an AC convention hall, 2 to 3 lecture halls, etc. The college provides transportation facilities also for the students. All events and fests are conducted on the college campus, and mostly all the festivals are celebrated here.

reviews.review_heading: Quite an awesome academic boosting experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is standard as any other standard institute of national importance although some of the departments are still underdeveloped. Hostels are provided for all and the mess is managed by a private management affiliated with the Institute. Food is also provided well, i.e., 4 meals a day for both veg and non-veg. The hostel facilities include fans, no AC, geysers, public bathrooms, and multiple toilets.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Nagaland offers proper facilities and faculty to the students in our course.
reviews.review_text: NIT Nagaland is having a well maintained and developed infrastructure for our course. College has a big campus with all kinds of necessary facilities. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports and other modern facilities are available for the students. Hostel are available there for the students. Food in the hostel mess is good. Facilities are also of good quality at the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Disappointed due to the faculty, but the hostel and overall environment are good.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and labs were quite good, and the library, though not bigger, was also fine, with some books related to their departments and space for studying. Coming to the hostel, it was a very good, comfortable, and secure accommodation, ideal for studying as well.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Nagaland - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are excellent and overall college is above 100 acres. Very good in nature and full-speed internet. And classrooms. The quality of hostel and food is excellent and very hygiene. The medical services are also available 24/7. The sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Nagaland - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi connection is good.
Now the library is small and is in the administrative block.
The two-story library is under construction (from Corona time).
Our classrooms are also under construction, just beside the library.
Now we are having classes in bamboo classrooms, which are temporary. Medical facilities are available.
24/7 hot water is available in hostels.
The daily hostel cleaning is done.
sports are conducted every semester
football ground was recently constructed.

reviews.review_heading: Not so good placement for civil, but worth it for a good college experience and healthy environment.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are very good. The mess is good. It's improving every year based on our ratings. Libraries and classrooms could get better. There's room for more improvement. We have bamboo classrooms for now for the civil departments. More department construction is underway.

review_summary.college_name: Institute of Technology, Nirma University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great private college for B.Tech.

content.Placements: I am still in my second year of mechanical engineering, but I know a bit about this year's placements. Our sir told us that this year, only a few students got placed with a maximum package of about 15 LPA in mechanical engineering. It seemed as if the students were only able to answer theoretical questions and not real-life application problems. Because studying here is very monotonous and boring. The placements this year were fewer than last year.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, Nirma is top-notch. They have a class with AC in some blocks and a spacious place. We have a good football and cricket ground. Basketball courts and volleyball courts are also there. There is a 5-storey library on campus, which is the best place to study during exams, and even though it is big, it is silent. There are many books from all departments and topics. We have 4 canteens with great food and great service. 2 of them close at about 4-6 pm, and the other 2 stay till 10 pm. The hostel mess also includes great food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Students life at Nirma University.

content.Placements: Mostly 95 percent of students are placed in campus placements. Some students choose to pursue a master’s degree for further studies. The highest package is 80 LPA, the lowest package is 3 LPA, and the average package offered is 8 LPA. Companies that frequently hire students on campus include Infosys, TCS, JPMC, Oracle, and Deloitte.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is surrounded by greenery. The architecture of the buildings is modern, with Wi-Fi, AC classrooms, and projectors. The classroom design is awesome. The library is modern and has six floors. The hostel facility is good. Multiple sports grounds, meetup places, and two or three canteens are available for students to relax and socialize.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Excellence of faculty members and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Total of 400 students are placed in computer science field every year. The highest package till year is CTC 52 LPA. The average salary is 10 LPA - 12 LPA. SDE and many more have been offered in the last 2-3 years when I was on campus. One internship in DE Shaw is also placed with pre-placement talks and PPO.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on campus. Classrooms are basic and computer labs are still under resource as some of them are still holder model and electricity issues sometimes occur. There is food issue in the canteen. Sometimes, when food is served, insects are there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Nirma University is a good private college.

content.Placements: Approximately, we have 80 students in one class, and two such classes. Placements are getting better year by year. The highest package in the ECE stream is approximately 53 LPA. The top recruiters are Google, NVIDIA, Amazon, Adani, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All rooms are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi facility is available for free. There is proper parking space, and the campus is surrounded by greenery. The canteen is affordable, hygienic, and offers the best food. There are four canteens K canteen, Pharma canteen, Law canteen, and MBA canteen and all of them are excellent. Labs are also well-equipped and among the best. The college has the best infrastructure and a peaceful environment without any stress.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: An honest opinion on Nirma University.

content.Infrastructure: There are multiple canteen on campus which provides a wide range of options. There is a gym, a playground for multiple sports and games. The campus is open from 10:30 AM to 11:00 PM for all. Those who live in hostels can stay inside. Overall, the facilities are good.
content.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio is good, there are many faculty members, and the number of students per class is limited. The curriculum design is good and in-depth. The exam system is a continuous evaluation, the result is not just based on the final semester exam. Some of the faculty members are good. The ability they have to make you understand the topic is great. Well, the curriculum covers all the topics in that domain with a good amount of practical. Industry experts are invited to give real-life scenarios about the real industry. The exams are not too difficult to pass, but to score one needs to work a little hard.
