Each person has gotten a minimum offer of 4 LPA, and the big companies are ready to come, so coming to the placements, they are really good.
content.Infrastructure: On campus, international students live in the hostel. All the students are helpful and belong to other parts of the world and the country. Mostly, 5:2 boys to girls live in the hostel campus, and there is equal respect for all. We celebrate all important functions on the hostel campus together. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The hostel is good, and their mess is super. I'm sure you won't get better food at home than in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Structural Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Please do some serious study and aim for IIT.

content.Placements: Students are eligible for placements from the 3rd sem. Companies such as Atkins Brigade and Shoba visited the college. The highest package offered was 7LPA. 70 Percent of students got placed. I plan to do a Ph.D. after this. There were internships provided by TCS Wipro and many companies.
content.Infrastructure: The library was vast with lots of books available. The classroom had projectors. We had a huge ground for sports. Clubs such as theatre club fashion club etc. Hostels were good they were mostly two seated. Mess food was average. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. There were cricket grounds volleyball court and many other grounds present.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I’m fortunate to be part of this institution.

content.Placements: About 40% of students are placed as of now. 15 LPA is the highest and 6 LPA is the lowest. Some Japanese companies, Oracle, Rabbit AI, Capgemini, and Accenture are the top recruiters. About internships, I don't have any idea. Roles offered are AI analyst, assistant engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms come with LED screens, a projector, and Wi-Fi. Hostels are provided with all the amenities, but students have to compromise with food. I’m a day scholar but have friends in the hostel who give mixed reviews about the hostel facilities. They have 24/7 medical support.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: We have good faculty and placements.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students are placed in our course. The highest package is 8 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is around 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Microsoft and TCS. Around 80% of students receive internship opportunities. The top roles offered are HR and Manager positions.
content.Infrastructure: The department facilities are good, and the overall infrastructure is also good. We have Wi-Fi in every classroom within the department. The library facilities are also good. The hostel is good with decent food. Rooms and washrooms are also good. There is also a ground in front of the hostel.

NMIT Bangalore offers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in Engineering, Management and Computer Applications streams. The deemed-to-be university offers courses such as BTech, BSc (Hons), MTech, MBA and MCA programmes. Besides, the institute offers PhD in various departments from Visveswaraya Technological University, Belgaum & University of Mysore. NMIT is a part of NITTE university, Mangalore. Interested candidates can apply online for the preferred course. Below is the overview of NMIT Bangalore admission process:

faqs.question: How are B.Tech placements at NMIT, Bangalore?
faqs.answer: Nitte Meenakshi Institute of Technology (NMIT) in Bangalore achieved a notable placement rate of 94.3% in 2023, reflecting its commitment to providing career opportunities for its students. The average package offered during placements in 2023 was INR 7.6 LPA, demonstrating the competitiveness and quality of opportunities available to NMIT graduates. The placement scenario at NMIT is dynamic, with an average and median package of INR 6.6 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively, showcasing a robust offering of positions for students across various disciplines. Notably, the International Package witnessed an impressive 11% increase compared to the previous placement year, indicating the global recognition of NMIT graduates. For the B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering programme, top recruiters such as TCS, Infosys, and Wipro contribute to the diverse placement landscape. Similarly, the B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering programme attracts leading companies like TCS, Accenture, Wipro, and Amazon, further underscoring the versatility of opportunities for students in different specialisations. To enhance students' employability, NMIT provides a proactive placement training program. This proactive approach is embedded in each department, fostering a supportive environment for students seeking career opportunities after graduation. The consistent efforts to bring diverse and reputable recruiters to campus contribute to NMIT's impressive placement records, solidifying its position as a sought-after institution for quality education and promising career prospects.

hostel.description: NMIT provides in-campus hostels for both boys and girls. Twin sharing rooms are available for 1st-year students. Second year onwards boys may opt for twin sharing or four sharing rooms. The hostel has amenities such as TV rooms, reading room, 24 hours medical emergency service van, co-operative stationary stores and many more.

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Multi-Purpose Track, Hockey Ground, Volleyball Court, Throw-ball Court, Table Tennis

labs.description: Available Facilities: Computer Lab, Electronics Lab, Structures Lab, Propulsion Lab, Surveying Lab, Material Testing Lab, CAD Lab, Data Base Management Lab, Microprocessor Lab, Object Oriented Modeling Design Lab, JAVA Lab, Circuits and Measurements Lab, Control Systems Lab, Hardware and Software Lab, Project Lab, Foundry and Forging Lab, Metrology and Measurement Lab, IoT Lab, 3D Printed Composites

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good for the masters.
reviews.review_text: NMIT provides on-campus hostels for both boys and girls with 1689 capacity. Twin-sharing rooms are available for 1st year students. Second year onwards, boys may opt for twin-sharing or four-sharing rooms. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Computer labs are spacious and have a good number of PCs. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and also air-conditioned. The library is good, and open till 12:00 AM.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very expensive college, but in Bangalore, it is common.
reviews.review_text: On campus, international students live in the hostel. All the students are helpful and belong to other parts of the world and the country. Mostly, 5:2 boys to girls live in the hostel campus, and there is equal respect for all. We celebrate all important functions on the hostel campus together. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The hostel is good, and their mess is super. I'm sure you won't get better food at home than in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Please do some serious study and aim for IIT.
reviews.review_text: The library was vast with lots of books available. The classroom had projectors. We had a huge ground for sports. Clubs such as theatre club fashion club etc. Hostels were good they were mostly two seated. Mess food was average. Wi-Fi was all over the campus. There were cricket grounds volleyball court and many other grounds present.

reviews.review_heading: I’m fortunate to be part of this institution.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms come with LED screens, a projector, and Wi-Fi. Hostels are provided with all the amenities, but students have to compromise with food. I’m a day scholar but have friends in the hostel who give mixed reviews about the hostel facilities. They have 24/7 medical support.

reviews.review_heading: We have good faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: The department facilities are good, and the overall infrastructure is also good. We have Wi-Fi in every classroom within the department. The library facilities are also good. The hostel is good with decent food. Rooms and washrooms are also good. There is also a ground in front of the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good library. It has collection of online and offline books. We have good facilities. Good interaction is there with students. We have good football court for playing games. There is a basketball court as well for sports. It has good facilities in general. The clubs are good as well in all departments.

reviews.review_heading: A wonderful experience in this green campus.
reviews.review_text: All the rooms are well-maintained and very hygienic. The food is good but it provides the same food every week. There is a medical center. There are various labs with high technology. There are places where students get a chance to focus on physical development. There is a gym and sports activities too.

reviews.review_heading: It is quite good until it became a university and stopped taking admissions from COMEDK and KCET.
reviews.review_text: We have big rooms in the hostels and smart classrooms in the college, with good sanitation that gets cleaned daily. There is a big football ground, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in the hostels. The mess food is not quite to my liking, even though they have improved it.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with supportive faculty and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: Our department offers a supportive academic environment with well equipped classrooms. Along with projectors and campus-wide Wi-Fi. It makes learning more interactive. Labs, especially in electronics, VLSI, and computing, are regularly updated. This gives us practical exposure beyond theory. The central library is a major advantage. It has a wide collection of books, journals, and digital resources. Along with quiet study space for focused learning.

reviews.review_heading: A short note on NMIT College.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi in NMIT is very poor, and the mobile network is hectic. I hate this thing about our college, the Wi-Fi network is not good, and mobile network is the worst. We can't send any message, or sometimes we don't get OTPs, etc. The labs here are good, and the systems are new, and they run smoothly.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, helpful faculty members, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good infrastructure for both academics and hostel. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards, while the labs are well-maintained with high-speed internet and updated software for practical learning. Library has a wide collection of books and digital resources. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and hostel. The food in the mess and canteen is average but hygienic, with multiple options available. Medical facilities are provided on campus along with emergency su...

reviews.review_heading: An average College with a good placement ratio.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are all good. They are good, knowledgeable, and all classrooms have access to Wi-Fi.  Love for different types of things. Library is overall good facilities. We got a ground to play on, and the canteen and the Mess are also nice. The food served is good.

reviews.review_heading: It has supportive faculty, a strong curriculum, and good placements. It is a great choice for E&C.
reviews.review_text: There are four boys' hostels and two girls' hostels. Rooms are furnished with a bed, study table, chair, wardrobe, shared common rooms, TV, reading or music rooms, solar water heaters, LAN+Wi-Fi, 24x7 power backup via generators, water coolers, and full security with CCTV. Mess offers both North and South Indian meals, with options to order extra items beyond the standard menu.

reviews.review_heading: NMIT Bengaluru provides good placements for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The college has classrooms, labs, and libraries with high-speed internet facilities provided. You can make self-preparation on your own.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and lectures.
reviews.review_text: College provided good hotel facilities like mineral water, water coolers, and washing machines. The bedrooms were good with attached bathrooms. The food quality was good. College infrastructure was good. The classrooms were in good condition. Labs were well qualified. Wi-Fi connection was available. Many books were available in the library. The medical facilities were good.

reviews_list.review_title: It is a smart and advanced college in the name of an engineering college.

review_content.Placements: The placement ratio is 90%, which means most students get placed. But the problem is that most students get placed in either TCS or Infosys. They are service-based companies and offer almost 3–4 LPA, while very few students, like 1 in 200, get placed in product-based companies.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. They have Wi-Fi with no internet connection. Classrooms are exactly like school classrooms, and there is no AC or cooler in the classrooms. The canteen is too small, the library is okay, but there are no good sports facilities. I can say that sports are below average.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: NIET has good placement. Faculty are very supportive, and the infrastructure is average.

review_content.Placements: NIET offers average placement opportunities, especially for core and emerging branches. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. The average package is around 6 LPA, and the highest package is around 52 LPA. Around 60 to 70 percent of students are placed. And some students get internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: Previously, the NIET infrastructure was very bad, but they have improved their infrastructure. The campus size is very small, but NIET has a total of 3 individual infrastructure plots 14, 15, and 19. Plot 15 are the newly made campus for first-year students. The campus life at NIET is very good. I extremely recommend first-year students to take the college hostel. The food quality is decent, Wi-Fi is good, and medical sports facilities are also very good. The infrastructure of classes is that every class has a smart board, but the tables are very bad. Canteens are very good.

review_summary.college_name: NIET Gr Noida Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A decent college with decent placements.

content.Placements: If you have a 7+ CGPA with no ongoing backlogs, there is almost a 90% certainly of in-campus placement. As the college has tie-ups with mass recruiters, you are likely to get a placement, but don't expect the placement numbers to be very good or satisfactory. Some recruiters include Infosys, TCS, HCL, etc. , with an average package of around 6 LPA and the highest touching up to 54 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here at NIET is honestly a bit of a mixed bag. For our CSE labs, the equipment is actually quite decent and up-to-date, and the smart boards in the classrooms make lectures easier to follow. The central library is huge and has almost every book you’d need, though it gets super crowded during exams. However, the Wi-Fi can be a real pain. It's okay in the labs, but in the hostel, the speed is pretty consistent, and they have a lot of blocked sites, which is frustrating when you're trying to work on projects.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Bad infrastructure and college life.

content.Placements: In my course, which is B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, there are about 240 students last year out of which about 120 to 140 are placed last year. The highest and the lowest packages are 39 LPA and 3 LPA respectively. The top recruiting companies are Accenture, Wipro, Razor, TCS etc. About the internship, there are only 4 to 5 students who got a properly paid internship from the college others are enrolled in internships. They are required to pay to get enrolled and some got to companies by outreaching to them. The top roles offered are software developers, frontend developers, backend developers etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a smart and advanced college in the name of an engineering college.

content.Placements: The placement ratio is 90%, which means most students get placed. But the problem is that most students get placed in either TCS or Infosys. They are service-based companies and offer almost 3–4 LPA, while very few students, like 1 in 200, get placed in product-based companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. They have Wi-Fi with no internet connection. Classrooms are exactly like school classrooms, and there is no AC or cooler in the classrooms. The canteen is too small, the library is okay, but there are no good sports facilities. I can say that sports are below average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: NIET has good placement. Faculty are very supportive, and the infrastructure is average.

content.Placements: NIET offers average placement opportunities, especially for core and emerging branches. Top recruiters are TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. The average package is around 6 LPA, and the highest package is around 52 LPA. Around 60 to 70 percent of students are placed. And some students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Previously, the NIET infrastructure was very bad, but they have improved their infrastructure. The campus size is very small, but NIET has a total of 3 individual infrastructure plots 14, 15, and 19. Plot 15 are the newly made campus for first-year students. The campus life at NIET is very good. I extremely recommend first-year students to take the college hostel. The food quality is decent, Wi-Fi is good, and medical sports facilities are also very good. The infrastructure of classes is that every class has a smart board, but the tables are very bad. Canteens are very good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Neutral placement and infrastructure is okay-okay.

content.Placements: Around 20-30% of students are placed in MCA. The highest package is 6 LPA, the lowest package is 3 LPA, and average is 3 LPA - 4 LPA. For recruiting, both technical and non-technical companies visit to hire students. Recruiting companies are TCS, Accenture, Infosys, and Capgemini. Top roles offered are software developer and technical support.
content.Infrastructure: College has two small campuses for computer application students, and classes are conducted in both campuses. Sometimes classes are held in one campus and sometimes in another, which became frustrating for the students. Wi-Fi, library, and classrooms are available. But there is no sitting area and lunch area for students. Computer labs are available and used for practical sessions.

reviews.review_heading: A decent college with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here at NIET is honestly a bit of a mixed bag. For our CSE labs, the equipment is actually quite decent and up-to-date, and the smart boards in the classrooms make lectures easier to follow. The central library is huge and has almost every book you’d need, though it gets super crowded during exams. However, the Wi-Fi can be a real pain. It's okay in the labs, but in the hostel, the speed is pretty consistent, and they have a lot of blocked sites, which is frustrating when you'...

reviews.review_heading: Bad infrastructure and college life.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are okay but there is a lack of air conditioning. We also raised a complaint to the dean about that but the management is too slow. Wi-Fi is also mess you only get 2GB data per day and you need to login with your I would everytime you are disconnected also there are many place inside the campus where internet speed is not good and even Wi-Fi gets disconnected hostel is okay we get proper food and there are not much complain about it infrastructure is kind old but renovation is don...

reviews.review_heading: It is a smart and advanced college in the name of an engineering college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very poor. They have Wi-Fi with no internet connection. Classrooms are exactly like school classrooms, and there is no AC or cooler in the classrooms. The canteen is too small, the library is okay, but there are no good sports facilities. I can say that sports are below average.

reviews.review_heading: NIET has good placement. Faculty are very supportive, and the infrastructure is average.
reviews.review_text: Previously, the NIET infrastructure was very bad, but they have improved their infrastructure. The campus size is very small, but NIET has a total of 3 individual infrastructure plots 14, 15, and 19. Plot 15 are the newly made campus for first-year students. The campus life at NIET is very good. I extremely recommend first-year students to take the college hostel. The food quality is decent, Wi-Fi is good, and medical sports facilities are also very good. The infrastructure of classes is that ev...

reviews.review_heading: Neutral placement and infrastructure is okay-okay.
reviews.review_text: College has two small campuses for computer application students, and classes are conducted in both campuses. Sometimes classes are held in one campus and sometimes in another, which became frustrating for the students. Wi-Fi, library, and classrooms are available. But there is no sitting area and lunch area for students. Computer labs are available and used for practical sessions.

reviews.review_heading: Not very satisfied with college but if we just want to come for placement opportunities than ok.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of college are just average, not good. But hostels are quite good or we can say above average. Food is decent, not very good. Medical facilities are okay as we can just get ever. In hostel, they have carrom, badminton, and some other games to play.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The quality of the hostel is good, the warden mam is a nice person and helpful. Lab facilities are present. Mess is good, and the canteen facility is also there. Infrastructure is there, and all facilities are provided, like a classroom, labs, library and auditorium.

reviews.review_heading: My personal experience of NIET.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the college and hostel. You have to generate your id. The hostel provides you with all your essentials. The food is okay, not bad. You have a ground for sports, and the canteen is also pretty good. You have a mother diary here also. Medical block is also available here.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good on the basis of its ROI, but when it comes to college life, that's not good
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very bad for 1-year students. The area of college is very small. No availability of ground and a good infrastructure, no well-developed libraries for hostelers, no proper courts for playing, and no playing culture is seen in this college. Hostel life is also very boring and difficult.

reviews.review_heading: College is average, infrastructure is average, but sometimes it feels faculty are skipping topics.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of classrooms and library is good. The labs are good, but the classrooms are a bit small. The hostel facility is average, but sometimes the mess food is not so good and is too spicy sometimes. Medical facilities are good, and currently the playground is being repaired.

reviews.review_heading: I really do not recommend this college. You can see other better alternatives.
reviews.review_text: Talking about the infrastructure, it is good, and the Wi-Fi facility in the library is also impressive. Classrooms are well furnished. The sports and games department and medical facilities are 8 out of 10. Food available in the mess is healthy to eat, and they make the food accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: In this college, the placement is good.
reviews.review_text: In this course, classrooms given to students are very well-maintained, and AC facilities are also provided in every classroom and lab. In each lab, proper internet is available, and PCs are provided to each student for their work. In the hostel, all facilities are provided. Mess food is good, and a canteen is provided on campus. There is a proper area of sports.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university in Noida for students.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of this course is good. It supports students for future purposes. There are many facilities, including 24/7 Wi-Fi. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The university has multiple libraries where students can study together. Many hostels are available. The food in both the canteen and hostel is good. The university also provides medical facilities. Sports events are organized every week.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and good placement ratio but average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides a good environment for students to stay focused towards their goal, and the faculty members are good and very helpful. The infrastructure is quite good; the labs are really good, fully AC, and all PCs are working properly. Classrooms are also fine, but I think they should install AC in every classroom because in summer time it is really hot. Overall, it is good; hostels and canteen are good, everything is available, and the medical room is quite fine.

reviews.review_heading: Workshops are key for learning coding.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is poor. The cafeteria is very small and not very clean. The campus has a small sports ground, one basketball court, and five blocks named A to E. There are two campuses. The old one and the new one, with the new campus for first-year students and the old campus for other years. There is a hostel on campus with Wi-Fi and hot water facilities in winter. A mess is also available inside.

paragraphs: IIITDM Jabalpur admissionsare granted based onJEE MainsandGATE scoresto its BTech and MTech programmes, respectively. It offers a wide range of courses in Design and Technology for both UG, PG and PhD level courses.IIITDM Jabalpurcourse admission isentrance exam-based.The institute inducts candidates for the flagship BTech programme through JoSAA/ CSAB counselling based on valid JEE-Main scores. BTech being the flagship programme of IIIT Jabalpur is offered across five programmes. If you're interested in pursuing any of the courses at IIITDM in Jabalpur, candidates can check the eligibility criteria before applying atIIIT Jabalpur

IIITDM Jabalpur offers various courses at UG, PG and PhD levels. The eligibility criteria for the courses are Class 12 and graduation with minimum marks and selection is based on an entrance exam. Here are some popular courses of IIITDM, Jabalpur with their eligibility and selection criteria:

The fees offered at IIITDM Jabalpur vary from course to course and depending upon the specialisation. The candidates must pay the registration fee, examination fee, etc., apart from the total tuition fee. Here are some topIIITDM Jabalpur courseswith their total tuition fee along with the seat intake as per the courses. The reserved seat will be filled as per government of India rules:
Note:This information is sourced from the official website and is subject to change. Check out the completeIIITDM Jabalpur Fee Structure

The IIITDM Jabalpur admission criteria are entrance-based. Candidates are shortlisted based on scores in the accepted entrance examination followed by respective selection rounds/counselling. The steps involved in the admission process are explained below:
STEP 1: IIITDM Jabalpur Application Process 2025

For IIITDM Jabalpur course admission must visit its official website to apply online. To apply for theBTechcandidates need to appear for theJEE Mainentrance exam. For MTech admission, candidates need to apply forGATE. Moreover, the aspirant shall ensure that the application form is submitted within the prescribed due date.
STEP 2: Release of Cutoff List

After the application process, the institute releases a course-wise cutoff list. The cutoff list indicates the minimum required score in the respective entrance exam for a candidate to become eligible for admission.
STEP 3: Counselling

Candidates applying for a BTech course further have to go throughJoSAA counsellingfor seat allotment and, for MTech admission, CCMT conducts the counselling round. While the candidates who apply for a PhD may have to go through an interview round.
STEP 4: Admission Confirmation
After the selection rounds and counselling, seats are allotted to the eligible candidates. Selected students can further pay the required fee to confirm their seats.

review_summary.college_name: PES University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am very satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: A total of 740 in the seniors' batch. Around 540 have been placed, and many have gone for higher studies. The highest package was 60 LPA. The median is around 12-13 LPA, and the lowest is not available. Companies like Zomato, IBM, Google, AWS, etc., come to this college. The top roles include SDE and ML engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Faculty have higher education with doctorate degrees, but the teaching is not very good. Most of the students self-study to score well. Infrastructure is 10/10. All the facilities are good, and everything you need will be available. As I am a day scholar, I don't know much about the hostel and mess.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: There are a lot of clubs technical and non technical which are worth.

content.Placements: In electronics and communication the placement was not that good compared to CSE till last year. The placements are decent for ECE but then in the last year there is a slight dip in the placements for CSE. The placement ratio is almost the same as before.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nice and has a lot of extracurricular sports and a lot of eating spots. There are separate places for the hackathons to be conducted. There are a lot of auditoriums. There are separate blocks of each branch like B.Tech B.Com BBA etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: One of the top colleges in Bangalore, with top-notch infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: Placements are really good, mainly because the college is located in a city like Bangalore. Compared to other colleges such as BMS and MSRIT, the placements are much better. They have a median package of 18 to 20 LPA for the AIML course, which is likely to increase in the future.
content.Infrastructure: The canteen and hostel facilities are really good. This might be the best thing about the university. The libraries are of top-notch quality. They have great basketball courts, badminton courts, and other sports facilities. The food available in the canteen is also amazing.

individual_reviews.course: B.B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure, but it can include more extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: So 80-90% of students from my course got placed in top companies, and most of us managed to get jobs through campus placement. The highest salary package offered in our course is around 25 to 26 LPA. The average package is roughly around 11-13 LPA. Some of the top companies include KPMG, Deloitte, HDFC Bank, TCS, DELL, etc. Around 80-95% students got internships, and some companies offering internships are Wipro and Accenture. The roles offered through placement and internships are legal advisory, business development, legal research, and consulting.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Completely worth a one-time investment.

content.Placements: According to our seniors and the placement information given by them, around 85-90% of the people who were eligible for placements were offered internships/placements. The highest package was around 56-60 LPA last year, the lowest was maybe 3.2 LPA, and the average is 12 LPA. The whole MAANG came itself. Everybody who was eligible got an internship. Software Engineer/ SDE-2, Data Analyst, and Data Engineer roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but restricted to one device only, and the internet doesn't come on the campus. Classrooms and faculty are all world-class. I'm a day-scholar, but as per my peeps, hostel food is bad. But the canteen food is top-notch. Sports facilities are also top-notch. Gym (10K for RR campus and 6K for EC campus), both are good.

Application forms are available online on the official website of the university. There is a application fee of INR 1,200 which needs to be paid for submitting the form.Candidates must also keep the specified documents ready for registration.

After submission of the form, the candidates have to book a slot for the PESSAT exam. This step is valid only for candidates appearing for PESSAT. Once they have booked their slot, an admit card will be issued. Aspirants must download their admit card.

PESSAT conducted by PES University is accepted for admission to all the courses. National or state-level entrance exams like JEE Main, KCET, GATE, etc. are required for admission to specific courses. PES conducts an interview round for shortlisted candidates for admission to some courses.

The selected candidates are further called for counselling and document verification. Aspirants need to payPES University feeto get a seat in the university. Once the fee is paid, candidates can report to the institute.

faqs.question: How can I get a seat in PES University?
faqs.answer: For getting seats in PES University, the student must satisfy eligibility criteria, give the PESSAT entrance exam, and then provide rank. faqs.question: Is PES University admission open?
faqs.answer: Yes, admissions to the UG and PG programmes conducted at PES University are now open. All applicants have to fill their online application form at the university portal and enroll themselves for entrance tests such as PESSAT or any other entrance test valid throughout the country.

It is the only entrance exam that the college looks into and includes for eligibility in their courses. However, in such exceptional cases like direct admission allowed for the high achievers, one may be exempted from the PESSAT process. Therefore, candidates have to clear the PESSAT exam with the prescribed minimum cutoff.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Faculty have higher education with doctorate degrees, but the teaching is not very good. Most of the students self-study to score well. Infrastructure is 10/10. All the facilities are good, and everything you need will be available. As I am a day scholar, I don't know much about the hostel and mess.

reviews.review_heading: There are a lot of clubs technical and non technical which are worth.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice and has a lot of extracurricular sports and a lot of eating spots. There are separate places for the hackathons to be conducted. There are a lot of auditoriums. There are separate blocks of each branch like B.Tech B.Com BBA etc.

reviews.review_heading: One of the top colleges in Bangalore, with top-notch infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The canteen and hostel facilities are really good. This might be the best thing about the university. The libraries are of top-notch quality. They have great basketball courts, badminton courts, and other sports facilities. The food available in the canteen is also amazing.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure, but it can include more extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text:
Facilities are quite excellent, including Wi-Fi for all and a specialised library for law. 
The quality of the hostel is also nice, but the food is not so much appreciated in the canteen, and it takes a lot of time to get prepared. 
There are quite a few sports games like football, basketball, badminton, etc. Including the top infrastructure courts for each sport.

reviews.review_heading: Completely worth a one-time investment.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but restricted to one device only, and the internet doesn't come on the campus. Classrooms and faculty are all world-class. I'm a day-scholar, but as per my peeps, hostel food is bad. But the canteen food is top-notch. Sports facilities are also top-notch. Gym (10K for RR campus and 6K for EC campus), both are good.

reviews.review_heading: You will experience every feeling in this college, good placements, and good friends.
reviews.review_text: Our college offers a fine infrastructure with high-speed Wi-Fi and a well-built library to study with all kinds of books. A well-maintained canteen, well-facilitated sports field, and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: PES: The real reason why to join PES.
reviews.review_text: The campus life, infrastructure, and both indoor and outdoor places are really well-maintained and well-equipped. This is one of the attractions at PES, where we get to see a huge block just for indoor sports and other co-scholastic activities. Here at PES, students get to play sports whenever they want, there are separate fields for different outdoor sports. One of the most attractive being is the cricket ground.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best private university, but the fee is too high.
reviews.review_text: For first-year students, the hostel is not on campus, but from the second year, the hostel is on campus. The Wi-Fi in both the college and the hostel is good. Facilities in the college are also good. The food is of good quality and quantity. Everything mentioned above is available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Worthy for course but not for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good and aesthetically pleasing. To sit and study we have quite big libraries and Wi-Fi is available but sometimes it is a trouble to connect with them. Moreover, we have a boys hostel inside the college campus and a girl's hostel outside the campus which is contact based and it is taken up by a living space company, for girls hostel which includes food and snacks for the hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with infrastructure and faculty, bit disappoint and concerned about placements.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, our college has the best facilities. They provide us all we need, including a study area. We have four different libraries, including one exclusively for the law department, which has a collection of even rare books. There is also a three-storied central library and an international-level moot court hall. We have courts for basketball, volleyball, badminton, and tennis, with a highly structured gym facility for students. There are six canteens that provide clean foo...

reviews.review_heading: Good Placements, Great Exposure, but Super Difficult Exams.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is pretty much okayish, not so good I would say because I have seen my friends complaining about the hostel food and all, and also they are building a new hostel now. Wi-Fi, sports, and games are always there, but unfortunately, I am not in the hostel, so I don't know what exactly is happening there.

reviews.review_heading: Not what I expected it to be.
reviews.review_text: The college provided good classroom and lab facilities. The hostel rooms are decent compared to other hostels. There are four canteens on the campus, and the quality of the food is good. The campus is clean and huge. We have small stalls for snacks and stationery inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: PES University at Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: PES University is a wide university including a lot of courses. Specialized lecturers are appointed for all the courses. A higher area is allocated for parking and sports courts. The library, with an extensive collection of books by various authors, was arranged in the college library.

reviews.review_heading: Slightly expensive for studies.
reviews.review_text: Students from different places come here to study, but there is no partiality or discrimination among them. The main aim of the college is to showcase the talents and skills of the students and help them succeed in their careers. But I'm not okay with the hostel food, so I would give it four stars.

reviews.review_heading: NammaPesu: An Honest Take.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good in our college. We have ample space for parking, playing cricket, football, and pretty much every outdoor sport. We also have 3 cafeterias, as well as a hospital upcoming in our campus itself. There is also a dedicated room for yoga, as well as a gym room.

reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is plentiful in my college and Wi-Fi connections are available for students 24/7. Labs are completely optimizable and well maintained. reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: I will give 10/10 for the infrastructure of our college. All classrooms are well-equipped with all necessary facilities; Wi-Fi is also available everywhere; and the library is also very good. The hostel is also good as far as infrastructure is concerned. But I heard some complaints about the mess foods.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a good infrastructure, but the academic pressure increases our tension.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good. Machines in labs are not accurate and do not have good precision. Wi-Fi is not available on campus, but it is available in the hostel with certain procedures. The canteen food is good but not worth the amount it costs. Only a few items are provided in the canteen. Sports grounds are available but not well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the care taken by them towards students.
reviews.review_text: Our college is known for its libraries which consisted of approximately 25,000 books to study and gain knowledge. High-speed Wi-Fi was provided to browse for studies and work easily. Classrooms were high-tech with projectors. We had a separate hostel for boys' and girls' safety. Each room was allotted for 4 students. The food served was top-notch. Medical facilities were provided. Students played games and reached more heights.

reviews.review_heading: Good and excellent in education.
reviews.review_text: It is a great learning experience. It has all facilities on campus. Academics is also very good. The faculty members are so coo-operative and supportive. They work hard for us and always welcome everyone to ask anything, discuss any problems one has. Our college has a rich library and a good big lab. The campus is really amazing. There are a lot of events and fests and workshops conducted throughout the session which is really interesting and specially career counselling sessions.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for gaining knowledge.
reviews.review_text: There is a high-tech infrastructure in this college with more laboratories and clubs. There is a good atmosphere in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Coimbatore in terms of placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and laboratories are excellent, and hostel rooms are very clean and good. There are a lot of books in our library, and a new auditorium and library would be constructed in our college. In the hostel, Wi-Fi is available.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

hostel.description: Punjab Engineering College has 6 hostels in total - 4 for boys and 2 for girls. All the hostels have Wi-Fi connectivity and other required amenities like water purifiers, recreation rooms, indoor sports, mess, common rooms, TV, laundry facility etc.

library.description:
Punjab Engineering College has a central library with the collection of of 1,15,452 volumes and an active collection of 30,267 books under Book Bank Scheme to support SC/ST as well as General categories students. The library uses a commercial Library Management Software (LibSys) and also provides intranet access to all its students through Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC). Central Library is also having Multimedia Resource Centre (MMRC) to make use of most popular mode of education i.e. Electronic Media with the help of ICT Technology and it has a collection of 1064 CDs, 143 floppies, 25 DVDs and 581 video cassettes on various disciplines of engineering and technology.

Library has also procured and installed NPTEL video and web courses on LAN of the institute for the benefit of the students. Students can access Internet and other subscribed e-resources at Multimedia Resource Centre (MMRC). Students can access over 2300 e-journals form publishers like ASCE Journals, ASME Journals, IEL Online etc.

Library is has Wi-Fi connectivity, book bank, reading hall, multimedia resources etc. and reading halls are open to students on all working days from 9:00 am till 8:00 pm.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college because it gives us all the facilities.
reviews.review_text: Full college Wi-Fi all over the campus. Labs are well-maintained, and the overall college infrastructure is average. There is a decent library with full facilities. Classrooms are very good, and the whole college is fully air-conditioned. Hostels are average, and food quality is also average, as in all NITs or other colleges. A medical dispensary is also available on campus. All types of sports and grounds are available with decent facilities, and there is also a gym.

reviews.review_heading: Peaceful life at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: Pretty campus, AC's in almost all classes except the old classrooms. For hostels, there are many restrictions. For girls, no one is allowed outside after 9, for boys, it’s a bit lenient. Clean rooms with windows. Boys’ hostel lacks a laundry though. A few small adjustments will have to be made.

reviews.review_heading: The college beats many top-tier colleges in terms of placement, and the overall experience is great.
reviews.review_text: Personally, I feel the infrastructure is quite updated and should be replaced, and development is ongoing. Everything a student needs is present on the campus. I like the library, computer labs, and reading area. The classrooms are equipped with smart projectors, and Wi-Fi is available throughout the building. The hostels are quite decent; again, the infrastructure is quite outdated, and the mess food is also decent. Sports facilities are available for every kind of game, like volleyball, cricke...

reviews.review_heading: Truth about the infrastructure of PEC, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: Classes lack Wi-Fi and internet connectivity due to jammers installed in the classes. The library is well-equipped with all the necessary facilities and Wi-Fi connectivity. The infrastructure of classes and labs is a bit too old. The facilities of the hostel are also just enough to survive, and the food quality is average. The canteen food is good. The college has enough facilities for endorsing sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: My college review, the one and only Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are not good, with decent infrastructure and a lack of facilities. Although the college is reputable, the infrastructure is not up to the mark, and Wi-Fi is also good. The library is decent, considering IITs, it is very below average, labs are good, and there are many labs.

reviews.review_heading: Punjab Engineering College Chandigarh review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of PEC Chandigarh is decent. First-year classrooms have AC, and the Computer Science department and ECE department also have AC. Wi-Fi is good. The infrastructure of labs is decent; some lab machines are old, while some have new machines. The library is good, and all types of books are available. Hostels are average but quite costly compared to other NITs. The mess is decent, and there is no hostel canteen. For medical facilities, there is a dispensary in PEC market where you ...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are just good enough for surviving. However, rooms are pretty small for two students, and only one table is provided in a room of two. The tennis table is broken and the snooker room is non-functional. The mess food is good for mess standards, but definitely not of top quality.

reviews.review_heading: It has strong academics, supportive faculty, good placements and comfortable campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is good and designed to support practical learning. We have well-equipped computer labs, high-speed internet, and updated software tools that help us in coding and project work. Hostel facilities are decent and well-managed. Rooms are clean and have basic furniture like beds, study tables, and cupboards. The canteen and mess food is simple and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: PEC Chandigarh College review.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of PEC Chandigarh is decent. First-year classrooms have AC, and the Computer Science department and the ECE department have AC. Wi-Fi is good. The infrastructure of labs is decent, some lab machines are old, and some have new machines. The library is good, and all types of books are available. The hostel is average but quite costly compared to other NITs. The mess is decent, and there is no hostel canteen or medical facilities. There is a dispensary in the PEC market where you...

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college with top-tier placements, good academic environment, and a nice atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure can surely be better. However, it is still manageable, with labs being allotted for every course. We have regular lab classes, promoting hands-on learning. The food quality is okay, and the hostel is also okay. Sports facilities are really good, with football, cricket, volleyball, basketball, lawn tennis, and badminton courts. It also has a great gym. I would say that PEC Chandigarh has a really good atmosphere.

reviews.review_heading: It's a beautiful college, and I am having a nice time here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is appreciable, classes are well built, spacious, and labs are nice. The department has its own building. We also have conference rooms and tutorial rooms. Hostels are good, rooms are good, but small for 2 people. Mess is average. There is a PEC market that has a dispensary. We have two 2 Nescafe outlets also. A lot of sports facilities are provided. We have a gym, a badminton court, volleyball, basketball, a tennis court, football, cricket, and an athletic ground.

reviews.review_heading: PEC is one of the top colleges in India. We have to get a great percentile in JEE Main.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is a bit old because the college itself is old. The food is above average. The PEC market is the best. Sports and facilities here are very good. I would rate the college 4 out of 5 stars. It is one of the top colleges in the whole country.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good, but it is a bit expensive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is mediocre, not very good, but it's okay for the placements. Wi-Fi is good, labs are old but are good enough, library is top-notch, classrooms for 1st year are amazing, but for the following three years, classrooms are okayish, hostels are quite old for 1st year, but are like a hotel for 4th year.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and amazing campus life but the infrastructure needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Our classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors, though some older blocks still lack ACs.The library is definitely the highlight, it's fully air-conditioned and has a massive collection of books and this is the go-to spot during exams. The campus-wide Wi-Fi is decent. Labs are well-equipped for the core. Hostel life here is an experience in itself. First year get shiwalik, which is old, and the rooms are compact. The washrooms are average and need frequent maintenance. The mess food is ...

reviews.review_heading: College is fine, but very overhyped.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is bad. The boys' hostel has very small rooms. Hostel food and cleanliness are average. In college, there are multiple dysfunctional labs. The robotics lab has machines which are out of order due to a lack of maintenance. The gym has old-school equipment, including very few weight plates, unlabelled dumbbells, non-adjustable pulleys, and dysfunctional machines.

lists: RVCE Application Process.The first thing that prospective candidates seeking admission to RV College of Engineering have to do is apply online. The official site is used to receive applications. The applicants should be able to submit the applications on time and remit the required application fees.

Application Screening and Entrance Examination.After receiving the application, the candidates are subjected to a screening process under the basis of the eligibility criteria and selection parameter. In the case of the PG course, such as the MTech, admission is done through national-level exams such as the GATE. In case of entrance exams in BTech such as CET, COMEDK JEE Main and KEA are taken into account.

Interview RoundsPotential employees can be shortlisted to undergo interview rounds. In the selection process of the programmes of the MTech, the GATE scores are mainly used. Interviews are important in determining the suitability of the candidates to specific courses.

Admission Confirmation Post-interview rounds.successful candidates are notified of their admissions over email or otherwise. In order to ascertain the admissions one has to complete the necessary formalities. They should be able to deliver the required papers within a given deadline. This guarantees them a slot in the programme.

reviews.review_heading: A good college with an excellent crowd and nice placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi quality is average at best (20 mbps at most). Many times the Wi-Fi doesn't even work. Hostels are okay, although the food could improve. Library is nice. Canteens are adequate. Sports could use a lot of work as the current ground is just a parking lot.

reviews.review_heading: Life in the RVCE College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: My college has multiple lecture halls as well as rooms for tutorial work, and also a seminar hall. There are many labs that come under my course total, which are around six, and the Wi-Fi speed is around 600mbps bandwidth, and is also available in almost every unit of the college. Library is also there with a vast variety of books and articles. My college has accommodation for both boys and girls on campus, in which rooms can be double, triple, or even more sharing options are available. There i...

reviews.review_heading: A life in my RVCE College.
reviews.review_text: Our department has multiple lecture halls, tutorial rooms, and a well-equipped seminar hall. The department has many labs, such as animal cell culture lab, plant biotechnology lab, genetic engineering and molecular biology lab, and many more. Department has its own library stocked with reference books, textbooks, and journals. Wi-Fi is enabled with a bandwidth of around 600 Mbps. RVCE has hostels for both girls and boys with double, triple, and many more sharing equipped with table, chair, and c...

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college
reviews.review_text: Hostel life is awesome. A very large area is occupied by the hostel in the college, with rooms having the required furniture, Wi-Fi, canteen, and mess (not compulsory). Students can move anywhere on campus 24×7. All festivals are celebrated in the hostels. Full freedom is given to students for good activities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall RVCE is good in terms of placement and studies.
reviews.review_text: Since the colleges are under construction nearly 30% of the colleges are inaccessible due to construction. The playground has become the parking area due to which sports can't be played where the lab and classrooms are well maintained and have a digital board due to now is your cooler you might feel hot in summertime. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is good as compared to the other colleges so in the food area you won't have many complaints.

reviews.review_heading: Review of RVCE in mechanical department.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my courses follows. We are provided with multiple options from which we can choose. Depending on the interest of the students, we are allowed to choose any of the courses. Talking about the hostel, the hostel fee is high compared to other colleges. But facilities like Wi-Fi, good rooms, and good food are available.

reviews.review_heading: RVCE is the top college in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are really big and spacious. The whole campus has central Wi-Fi for students, and all the labs are well-equipped for even performing research. The library is newly inaugurated, wonderful, and the perfect place to study. The hostel facilities are good. The food served in the mess is moderate. Sports facilities are moderate as well.

reviews.review_heading: Masters in structural engineering at R. V. College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Most informative resources that were available in the library like updated newspapers, journals periodicals, and reference books used for courses were collected and stocked in the library once a month. Biometric systems were used in the libraries instead of manual systems.

reviews.review_heading: Review of RV College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: It was established in the 90's, so the infrastructure is not that great. We have all facilities. The college is constructed newly. Recently, a new library was built, which is posh and has technologies like sound-proof and is a place where everyone would love.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and infrastructure of RVCE.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are really big and spacious. The whole campus has centralized Wi-Fi for students, and all the labs are well-equipped for even performing research. As the library is newly inaugurated, it is wonderful and just the perfect place to study. The hostel facilities are good. The food served in the mess is moderate, and the sports facilities are moderate as well.

reviews.review_heading: Come only if you want placements.
reviews.review_text: The library is quite good and newly built. Classrooms are currently under construction and will be completed in one year.  Students are currently attending classes in another branch's building. While the writer lives in a PG, they note that the hostel food is not good.

reviews.review_heading: It is best to enjoy a course with better placement and experience.
reviews.review_text: In my department, we have a vast library with supportive internet and a computer lab. We also have different classes for lab and theory sessions, which are well-equipped. The hostel is okay when compared to other hostels, but the food is good. Medical facilities are available 24/7. Each block has a gym, game courts, and fields for practicing.

reviews.review_heading: My experience of RV college of engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the college is good. We have separate buildings for the separate branches, and the infrastructure of the hostel is also good. We have Wi-Fi availability everywhere on the campus, and labs are also good. The library is newly constructed for both RVCE and RVU with good infrastructure. The food quality in the hostel is good, but the worst case is they provide the same food every day; there is no change to the food menu for your money.

reviews.review_heading: If you want to develop and learn, then this is the perfect place for you.
reviews.review_text:
The hostel we got is brand new, and they will provide 24/7 Wi-Fi and hot water. They inaugurated a new library by the Brigade Foundation in December 2024.
In the hostel, you will get different types of food, North Indian, South Indian, and the taste is decent enough. There is no non-veg, but you can have non-veg and junk food in the canteen called Mingos. For sports and games, they are building a gymnasium, which we can use by July 2025. Until then, we can play in the outdoor grounds provided by...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good, and the infrastructure is average as we thought before. Classrooms, labs, and the library are good. Wi-Fi is slow. In the hostel, facilities are good, and food is also good, but in the morning, it's very bad. We don't know why it is like this. We play all sports and games on the same ground, including cricket, kabaddi, football, volleyball, kho-kho, hockey, throwball, etc.

reviews.review_text: Labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is provided only in the hostel and labs. Classrooms are neat and clean, and the library is also good. Coming to food, it is nice and tasty. You have a variety of canteens inside the campus which you can use. Medical facilities are also good. Game tournaments are conducted frequently good practice is also given.

reviews.review_heading: College offers a perfect blend of studies and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our college has Wi-Fi in classrooms, computer labs with good systems, and a library with many books and e-resources. The labs are updated and are useful for practical learning. Hostels are neat with basic facilities like cupboards, study tables, and 24/7 water. The mess food is average but hygienic, and the canteen has better options. We also have a medical room, sports grounds, a gym, and indoor games. Overall, the facilities are good for both studies and daily life.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college to improve your knowledge and skills.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are neat and clean. Labs are also neat and clean. At Rajalakshmi Engineering College, the library is good. The hostel facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: Not only focus on academics, but also on other domains like sports, skills, etc.
reviews.review_text: Labs here have every facility, including the machines, components, electronic devices, and gadgets that are required to do the experiments. Devices are then and now checked for their efficiency and working, and changed and repaired accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: College review by the student in the college.
reviews.review_text: All good about the facilities and infrastructure available for our course and department. Food is moderate and the staff are above average. There was a health center in our college. They give a big opportunity in games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: College and placements are good. Getting a seat through counseling is better.
reviews.review_text: Information Technology and Computer Science have similar curricula. The hostel is just above average; 6 sharing beds in Habitat is okay, but the food was the worst. The campus is hygienic, with greenery around. The computer labs have basic facilities. Otherwise, it has good infrastructure, and there is a teachers' lounge.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with our chosen faculty. Improvements have been made this year.
reviews.review_text: Now non-veg is also available, but I think it's only for boys. I don't know about it clearly, but non-veg for boys for sure. Wi-Fi is not good in all surroundings. Only in some areas can we get a good connection. Quality teachers are available. More events like teaching events exist; if we use them in a fine way, we can shine for sure.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not top-tier, but good. Hostel facilities are also good, but the food served in the hostel is one of the worst. If you opt for the AC hostel. There won't be a non-vegetarian menu option for you, non-vegetarian food is provided in non-AC hostels for boys, but only 3 times a week.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Rajalakshmi Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is average, and food is also average. Classrooms are neat. Library is very neat and silent, and most of the useful books are available in the library. Canteen is also neat, and the food is average. REC promotes sports and games normally. Medical treatment is really good.

reviews.review_heading: Basically, placements are good in our college. I prefer students join this college for sure.
reviews.review_text: Our college facilities and infrastructure are very good. The hostel accommodation could be improved. They are cleaned daily. The food options in the hostel are repetitive and not enjoyable. It is very good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the infrastructure and the playground.
reviews.review_text: The new hostel, the food, and the infrastructure are good, but the old hostel is not up to the level of average. Our course is very good and it makes our future bright, so that we can make our career in the best way. Many other students can easily crack the interview with their help.

reviews.review_heading: In the past year, most of the students got placements and some went for higher studies.
reviews.review_text: Two big laboratories are available in our college. Wi-Fi is available in every canteen, and network at every single lab. Many classes contain smart boards. I am a day scholar, I got partial good feedback from hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, solid syllabus, and needs better industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: Department facilities are smart classrooms with projectors, high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped AI & ML labs, and access to a central library with online journals. Hostel rooms are decent with 24X7 Wi-Fi and good maintenance. Mess food is average. Canteen has better options. On-campus medical center is available for basic health needs. It has large playground, indoor games, gym, and regular sports events.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good for all including extra-curricular activities.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides 24X7 internet lab, free Wi-Fi across campus and hostels, 1.155 Gbps dedicated leased line, and more than 2000 PCs/laptops with fibre-optic backbone. It has lecture-capturing system, interactive panel, LCD projectors, and smartboards in all seminar halls and classrooms. It has 244 total labs, including 113 computer labs, plus specialized research and center of excellence facilities.

review_content.Placements: In the year 2024, 85 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered was 40 LPA, and the lowest package offered was 3 LPA. Infosys and many more companies visit the college for recruitment. Top roles offered in BCA (AI/ML) are data scientist, AI engineer, machine learning engineer, and data analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has a fully Wi-Fi campus and well-maintained infrastructure for BCA/ BCA (AI/ML), and also for other students. The university organises sports.

reviews_list.review_title: I'm really grateful and thankful for the quality education.

review_content.Placements: There are college placements present in the course. The duration for this placement or internship is 1 year. It's a paid one, along with good patient exposure and the best treatment modalities. Interns are allowed to assist and perform complex surgical procedures.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college is really well built, along with all the newly modified machines. AC is present in the lecture halls, clinicals, labs and clinics. reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Decent college with abundance of opportunities.

review_content.Placements: There are no outside placements offered by the college, but the college itself offers an internship of one year with a pay of approximately 3500 rupees. The interns have fair exposure to patients, from great OPD numbers to various extractions and everything in between.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and libraries are fully equipped with all essential things and are fully air-conditioned, although the labs and clinics are not. The college offers a perfect environment for preparation for NEET PG.

reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied overall.

review_content.Placements: Pharma.D course is the best for someone in search of their career in pharmacovigilance, research, and clinical pharmacology. It opens doors to the hospital as well as pharmaceutical industries. Pharma.D course will also help you work on your research projects and study both human body and medicine.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel provides a safe and secure environment with the best quality food and living. Guards are available 24 hour at our services. It has 24 hour ambulance, and hospital is also available nearby. Our campus is supportive and calm at every point with great living for both boys and girls.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Marketing Management - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Overall, college is good here.

review_summary.college_name: Sharda University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sharda School of Engineering and Technology.

content.Placements: In the year 2024, 85 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered was 40 LPA, and the lowest package offered was 3 LPA. Infosys and many more companies visit the college for recruitment. Top roles offered in BCA (AI/ML) are data scientist, AI engineer, machine learning engineer, and data analyst.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has a fully Wi-Fi campus and well-maintained infrastructure for BCA/ BCA (AI/ML), and also for other students. It has well-structured labs with a high configuration system. Classrooms have AC. I will never see such a big library in my life. The canteen is okay. The food served is average, like all messes. The university organises sports.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I'm really grateful and thankful for the quality education.

content.Placements: There are college placements present in the course. The duration for this placement or internship is 1 year. It's a paid one, along with good patient exposure and the best treatment modalities. Interns are allowed to assist and perform complex surgical procedures.
content.Infrastructure: The college is really well built, along with all the newly modified machines. AC is present in the lecture halls, clinicals, labs and clinics. Library is well AC centralized and all the necessary books are also present in the library. I do not have much information about the hostel as I am not a hosteller.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Decent college with abundance of opportunities.

content.Placements: There are no outside placements offered by the college, but the college itself offers an internship of one year with a pay of approximately 3500 rupees. The interns have fair exposure to patients, from great OPD numbers to various extractions and everything in between.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and libraries are fully equipped with all essential things and are fully air-conditioned, although the labs and clinics are not. Only decent infrastructure is available. The college doesn't have its own auditorium, instead, audit from departments is used when any event is to be held. The college offers a perfect environment for preparation for NEET PG.

individual_reviews.course: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied overall.

content.Placements: Pharma.D course is the best for someone in search of their career in pharmacovigilance, research, and clinical pharmacology. It opens doors to the hospital as well as pharmaceutical industries. Pharma.D course will also help you work on your research projects and study both human body and medicine.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel provides a safe and secure environment with the best quality food and living. Guards are available 24 hour at our services. It has 24 hour ambulance, and hospital is also available nearby. Our campus is supportive and calm at every point with great living for both boys and girls.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Marketing Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Overall, college is good here.

content.Placements: Approximately 60% of students are placed in our course BBA. Average package is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. There is no such top recruiting company for our course. Around 80% of students got internships from our course, and mainly companies hire for sales. Top roles offered in our course are for sales.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are okay and upto the mark. All the classrooms are fully air-conditioned and classes are tidy. The main attraction of the college is the library. Library is super, and it creates a workaholic environment. There are many canteens from which you can purchase healthy food.

admission_overview.college_name: Shoolini University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection Process & Dates

paragraphs: Shoolini University is accepts admission on a merit basis and an entrance basis.The university admits nationally level exams such as SAT India, JEE Main, CUET, CAT, MAT, etc.Additionally, Shoolini offers an entrance exam, known as SU-SAT, in selectcourses.With more than 180 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in fields such as Science, Engineering, Management, Commerce, Pharmacy, and Law,among others, students are offered a great choice.Lateral entry admissions and Summit Research Program courses in Engineering are also permitted in the university.

The University offers various courses in the fields ofEngineering, Law and Science etc. Students seeking admission must meet the course specific eligibility and selection conditions. However, the university also offers a BTech Lateral Entry course. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularShoolini University courses.
CUET UG/ SU-SAT/JEE Main/SAT India+ Faculty Interaction
The admission process at Shoolini University consists of multiple s, which are as follows.

1. Shoolini University Application Process 2025Candidates are required to apply online for all courses offered by Shoolini University. During the application, an application fee needs to be paid. For BBA, BCom, and MBA courses. Students can check the detailed Shoolini University fee structure here.

2. Selection RoundsShoolini University admits students based on various entrance exam scores such as CLAT, GMAT, MAT, etc., for various course admission such as BA LLB, BBA, BDes among others. For UG and PG courses, the selection criteria for PhD course admission is based on a multiple-choice entrance test and assessment of research aptitude through concept notes & faculty interaction.

3. Merit List & CounsellingBased on the candidates' performance in the selection rounds, the university prepares a merit list. Those who find their names on the merit list are invited to the counselling round. During this stage, candidates need to confirm their admission by paying the required fee.

paragraphs: Shoolini University has a placement cell responsible for securing lucrative career opportunities for students. The University invites companies of various sectors to conduct the Campus interview process at the University premises. The placed students also get the opportunity to do their final project in the placed company as interns with a stipend at this phase. After successful completion of the internship, the students can get full-time employment.

Further, over 500 recruiters participated and presented over 5,000 jobs to the students of the 2024 batch . The top recruiters who participated during the recent placement drives at Shoolini University included IBM, CITRIX, Cognizant, Polaris, LG Electronics, Genpact, Hughes Systique, Tata Hitachi, Code Brew, Net Solution, Nestle, etc.
