reviews.review_heading: A place to relax and win in life.
reviews.review_text: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: The university location is great and peaceful.
reviews.review_text: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.
reviews.review_text: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several time...

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: This university is good for your overall development.
reviews.review_text: The college has modern infrastructure, and the hostels provide very good services, especially in my hostel, for village students. The boys' hostel is located off the campus, and the girls' hostel is on the campus. There is 24 hour Wi-Fi service available. The labs are good, and there is an Apple lab in the AI block.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and my college offers a great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed, with spacious classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs that support practical learning. The department also has access to a good library with relevant reference materials and digital resources. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and regular maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: It has great labs for research and a peaceful campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped with different facilities. For food technology students, there are advanced labs for research. The university itself carries many patients which helps a lot in research programs. It has modern classrooms with Wi-Fi ensuring a seamless learning experience. The hostel is good here. There is an indoor cafe built in girls' hostel. It has different games and modernized infrastructure which make it feel like our second home.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are good. The washrooms are clean, classrooms are clean and spacious, and there is good Wi-Fi connectivity. The library is also amazing, open 24/7, 365 days a year, which is the best part. The hostel is also good, with good rooms, good food, and medical facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus and reliable faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very bad. Labs are not that bad. Quality of food is okay-okay. Some of the classrooms are very well-facilitated, and some are good ones. Good medical facilities are available. From time to time, game matches are held, and there is a sports complex with a gym also included in it.

reviews.review_heading: Strong digital marketing program with great placement and scenic campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has smart classrooms and high-speed Wi-Fi. The infrastructure is modern and well-maintained. Hostel is clean. The mess food is decent with a mix of dishes, and the mess offered good snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports like basketball, volleyball, badminton, and gym are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: The environment and atmosphere here are really good.

reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. I didn't opt for a hostel, so I don't know about it. There are clean washrooms, a 24/7 library, and good Wi-Fi. Application Process 2025

content.Placements: I'm currently studying B.Tech in AI, and till now, no batch has passed out yet for this course. The first batch will be passing out in 2025. But for other branches of B.Tech, I would say that the placements are below average. In 2023, the median package was 6 LPA and the highest was 12 LPA. Considering fees and other expenses, this is definitely a bad ROI. This year, I got to know from my seniors that companies like TCS have tests with 4 levels, and your salary is decided based on how many levels you clear. For clearing level 1, it is 4 LPA, level 2 is 5-7 LPA, level 3 is 7-9 LPA, and level 4 is 10/10+ LPA. After the tests, there is an interview, where they will decide the final salary from the range in which you have landed after the tests. Mostly all the companies that go to B.Tech colleges come here for placements as well, like TCS, Accenture, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life with a good placement offer.
reviews.review_text: Great infrastructure with a full Wi-Fi campus and a big enough library with most of the books. Our campus has 3 cafes, one inside the building and two in the garden. Our college has a big ground on which students can play, sit, and roam around, and also the whole university is very clean.

reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University is a very good college for B.Tech. Also, it is good for management.
reviews.review_text: The NorthCap University is not that big, and it has around 10 acres of land. The overall infrastructure is good. Classrooms are fully equipped. The library has all the books that are recommended by the teacher. Hostel is also good. One thing I can say is that the food is good and cooked with hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The NorthCap University!
reviews.review_text: The college campus is well-equipped with Wi-Fi (we are given 2GB of Wi-Fi, which is kind of less). Our classes are fully air-conditioned with good seating from where the board is clearly visible. The food at the campus is also good with varieties available.

reviews.review_heading: Great Infrastructure and Facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. It is equipped with all the things needed by a student. The library is updated with books, classrooms have smart boards, and Wi-Fi is provided to each and every student. The canteen is great, providing yummy snacks.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of placements. Good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very decent. They don't have any hostel, but the infrastructure is good; they have Wi-Fi at every corner with decent speed. The library is also up to mark. I would say they have the best canteen, in my opinion. The area of the college is small, which is why it has low sports facilities, but it has good medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure and Supportive Faculty. Worth a Try!
reviews.review_text: My university has air-conditioned classrooms, a library, a common room, an amphitheater, an auditorium, Wi-Fi facility, a Thought Lab, a Psychology Lab, cafes, a Maggi Point (NESCAFE outlet), and a sports room for indoor sports like chess, carrom, and table tennis. There are also basketball and badminton areas, multiple washrooms, and drinking water facilities on each floor.

reviews.review_heading: Review: The Northcap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, with air-conditioned classrooms and a large library containing thousands of books. No hostels are available for boys; hostels are only available for girls, and there are limited seats in the hostels. Many games and sports are available, such as cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Choose the right college for you .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is way to good; they provide us with AC classes, perfect benches, comfortable smart boards and a perfect garden, which gets awarded for the best garden award almost most of the time. It also provides us with 2 cafes and 1 Nescafe, providing healthy food and junk food .

reviews.review_heading: Crowd is not good but the faculty is good. The campus is average but small, no hostel for boys.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms have projectors for better teaching and creative learning. The students use these projectors for delivering presentations too. The Library is good having adequate collection of books. But the Wi-Fi is not that good and only provides 2GB for each student daily, the downloading speed is very good but the browsing speed is slow. There is only a girls hostel which is located 1KM away from the campus and there is no boys hostel available. The food quality is good in the cafes. Medi...

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really good, but it is not good for the sports students.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good but there are not a lot of things that should be covered in the facilities. The courses are good. They should also provide boys hostel facilities. They only have female hostel facilities. The hostel food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty and infrastructure with great placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities provided by the universities. Wi-Fi is fully available throughout the campus and labs, classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Libraries are also very clean and fully air-conditioned. The hostel facilities are also very good and the quality of food is also very hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The Northcap University- Gurgaon.
reviews.review_text: We do not have hostel facilities. Only a girls' hostel is available. Food quality is very average. Wi-Fi and canteen facilities are also available. The taste of food in the canteen is very nice, food tastes like homemade food. Hostel rooms are cleaned every day in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: Strong Industry Connections and Supportive Faculty at The NorthCap University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi was available and access was given to all. The library is large enough for a perfectly calm study environment. The classrooms are good, with centralized AC all over the campus. The ground is huge, and the cafe facilities are a bit tiring as they don't deal in cash but only with canteen cards.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Facilities include accommodation for both girls and boys, a health centre, a well-stocked library with both online and sprint resources, a gymnasium, a multipurpose sports ground, a cafeteria, auditorium and well-equipped laboratories. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is decent.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in terms of infrastructure, safety, and facilities. Faculty are helpful and supportive.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are really nice and well maintained. I am a day scholar, but according to my friends who have told me about hostels, they are not inside the college; they are outside the college, and they are only for girls.

individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with my college for placements and the knowledge gained.

content.Placements: 31 students out of 140 have been placed till now. The average package offered is 4LPA, and the highest package offered is 14LPA. The top recruiting companies are Wipro, TCS, Caterpillar, Zoho, Embed your, and so on. A few got internships in TCS and Fidelity. I do not know about the roles offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi can be a little bit better, but the classes and rooms near the outer get good Wi-Fi. Lawns, classrooms, and the library possess a good infrastructure and also better facilities. The mess and canteen offer only veg food, which is also good. Our college gives importance to both sports and studies.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Big college with best placements.

content.Placements: Nearly 85% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Adobe. The top roles are Project manager and software developer. Around 70% of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are good and the best. The B.Ed rooms are good with attached bathrooms. Washing machines and gym facilities are available. The canteen is also available. The college infrastructure is good. The classrooms and labs are good. We have a huge library. The Wi-Fi facility is also available. The medical facilities are good.

individual_reviews.title: I am truly satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: Nearly 75% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Anagram Architects and Sanjay Puri Architects. The top roles offered are interior designer and urban planner. Around 65% of students got internships.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are so nice at this college compared to other colleges. The hotel food is like homemade food. Bedrooms are neat with attached bathrooms. The college infrastructure is above average. Classrooms are in good condition. Facilities are available. The library and labs are good. The canteen is also available.

content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were really good. The college has a modern computer lab. Wi-Fi was enabled on the campus. The library was well-stocked with books. Food in the hostel was acceptable. A first aid medical facility was available.

faqs.answer: The path of admission to BTech in Veermata Jijabai Technological University goes through taking MHT-CET, a state-level entrance test conducted by the Government of Maharashtra under the Department of Technical Education (DTE). The candidates first have to register for MHT-CET from the official website, and the registration window for the said entrance exam usually opens between March and April.Students interested in getting admission to the BTech course of VJTI should prepare well for the said entrance exam because only those students who have scored well and whose rank lies within the range specified by the college are eligible for further process of counselling and seat confirmation.
faqs.question: Q: How can I get admission to VJTI for BTech?

faqs.answer: The Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering, or GATE, is the main entrance exam that VJTI Mumbai accepts for admission to the M.Tech program. To apply, candidates must have a current GATE score.PG-CET: This exam is administered by the Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell to applicants for admission to M.Tech programs in Maharashtra's institutions. PG-CET results are accepted by VJTI Mumbai for candidate screening.The entrance exam for Maharashtra State, M.Tech admission is called ME-CET, or the Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell. The VJTI accepts scores.JEE Mains/Advanced: Candidates with exceptionally strong B.Tech academic records may have their JEE scores taken into consideration by VJTI.CET: A few Common Entrance Exams administered by Central Universities are occasionally accepted as well.MAT/CMAT
faqs.question: Q: Which entrance exam scores does VJTI Mumbai accept for admission to M.Tech?

faqs.answer: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute mainly intake students in the BTech course through MH-CET whose supervisory body is Department of Technical Education (DTE) under the Government of Maharashtra. Also, the VJTI follows guidelines and other instructions laid down by MH-CET.Apart from MH-CET, there is an ambiguity whether Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute accepts JEE-Main score/ rank or not because there is no exact information available on the official website of VJTI. review_summary.college_name: VJTI Mumbai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placements, supportive faculty, and active campus life.

content.Placements: I am from the B.Tech Electrical Engineering (2023–27 batch). In my course, around 70–75% of students got placed in the previous batch. The highest package was around 12 LPA, the average was around 4.5 LPA, and the lowest was around 2.5 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, L&T, and a few core companies like Siemens. About 60% of students also got internships in companies such as Tata Power and Bosch. The top roles offered were graduate engineer trainee, software engineer, and junior design engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The college has well-maintained classrooms, projectors, and good Wi-Fi in labs and the library. Labs are updated with the equipment needed for electrical engineering experiments. The library is big with digital access, too. Hostel rooms are decent with proper ventilation, water supply, and 24/7 security. The mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities like cricket and football grounds, badminton, and indoor games are available. Medical facilities are also provided on campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Textile Technology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Strong academics, good exposure, and lively campus life at VJTI by Prabhu.

content.Placements: In the textile technology course at VJTI, around 65 to 75% of those women are generally placed through the campus and off-campus opportunities. Highest package offered in recent years has been around 8 to 10 LPA, with the average salary lying in the range of four to five, with the lowest package around 2.5 LPA. Some of the companies that visit are Reliance Textile and Century Enka.
content.Infrastructure: Textile Technology Department of College is well-equipped with specialized laboratories such as pinning, weaving, dyeing, printing, and textile testing labs, which provide students with hands-on industry-level exposure. The classrooms are spacious and fitted with projectors, and Wi-Fi is available across the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering (Sandwich) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: VJTI Mumbai is the best college in Mumbai after IIT Bombay.

content.Placements: According to seniors, placements are quite good at our college. In fact, the average package for CS and IT branches is 22 LPA. The overall placement rate across all branches ranges from 80-90%, with an average package of 13 LPA. The VJTI TPO is doing a good job for student placements.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about infrastructure, it is below average, but they are doing their best to improve it. They are making sure that every classroom and labs have basic amenities. The canteen is quite affordable, but do not provide much medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great college, one of the best.

content.Placements: Placements are really good. There is not a single day when the Training and Placement office is empty. Once the placement season starts in August, companies offering really good packages keep coming until the end of July. If you are good at what you like and what the companies demand, you are sure to get a job.
content.Infrastructure: Being a government institute, there is not much you can expect. The funds are not used where they should be. Most of the funds are used to pay the salaries of the contractual faculty. However, there are a few world-class laboratories where quality work is done. Most of these labs are industry-backed and are supported well by the institute.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Electronics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Best for placements, one of the top colleges for a reason.

content.Placements: You need at least 80% to get in. The minimum would be 6 LPA, but it could scale up to 13-20 LPA for companies like Tata, Infosys, etc. Currently, we are all interns at companies like Central Railway, BEST, Accord Electro Technics, TIFR, etc. The top roles offered are representative, event manager, and club representative.
content.Infrastructure: All classrooms and some sitting areas have Wi-Fi, and the network strength is very good. The library also has Wi-Fi, and it's vast—you can find any book you want from diploma to degree level. The sitting area is large and appears quite premium, I guess. The hostel is also very good and clean. The mess offers tasty meals, and the rooms are quite nice. For sports and games, the hostel ground is very large and well-maintained. We also have a gymkhana offering games like carrom, chess, and table tennis.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive faculty, and active campus life.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-maintained classrooms, projectors, and good Wi-Fi in labs and the library. Labs are updated with the equipment needed for electrical engineering experiments. The library is big with digital access, too. Hostel rooms are decent with proper ventilation, water supply, and 24/7 security. The mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities like cricket and football grounds, badminton, and indoor games are available. Medical facilities are also provided on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics, good exposure, and lively campus life at VJTI by Prabhu.
reviews.review_text: Textile Technology Department of College is well-equipped with specialized laboratories such as pinning, weaving, dyeing, printing, and textile testing labs, which provide students with hands-on industry-level exposure. The classrooms are spacious and fitted with projectors, and Wi-Fi is available across the campus.

reviews.review_heading: VJTI Mumbai is the best college in Mumbai after IIT Bombay.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, it is below average, but they are doing their best to improve it. They are making sure that every classroom and labs have basic amenities. The canteen is quite affordable, but do not provide much medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Great college, one of the best.
reviews.review_text: Being a government institute, there is not much you can expect. The funds are not used where they should be. Most of the funds are used to pay the salaries of the contractual faculty. However, there are a few world-class laboratories where quality work is done. Most of these labs are industry-backed and are supported well by the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Best for placements, one of the top colleges for a reason.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms and some sitting areas have Wi-Fi, and the network strength is very good. The library also has Wi-Fi, and it's vast—you can find any book you want from diploma to degree level. The sitting area is large and appears quite premium, I guess. The hostel is also very good and clean. The mess offers tasty meals, and the rooms are quite nice. For sports and games, the hostel ground is very large and well-maintained. We also have a gymkhana offering games like carrom, chess, and table te...

reviews.review_heading: There are top-notch placements for all branches.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is average. The PG hostel is top-notch, but not everyone gets that. The other hostels are around average, but they are affordable and budget-friendly, with fees around Rs. 22,000 for a normal hostel and Rs. 44,000 for a PG hostel. The food is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute - VJTI Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The college is the topmost college. It has a nice campus and nice teachers. There is a good positive vibe for students. It is a government college, so it has its own hostel and mess. The fee for the hostel is Rs. 12,000 for a year with mess and that is much less according to other hostels in Mumbai.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good. They have many labs and clubs which help students to find their interests. Hostel facilities are also good hostel has recently been renovated and a new hostel has also been built. There are many labs in our campus which are good.

reviews.review_heading: I like environment of campus. Campus is 16 acres.
reviews.review_text: Rooms are very quiet enough not saying that they are best. The food of mess is very good as compared to other college's mess. The process for registration of hostel is through your MHT CET scorecard.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.Tech. in Textile Technology course in VJTI.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on campus, but it may not work in some areas. There are 2 hostels for boys, 1 PG hostel old and one is in very bad condition. It has toilets and a living room. PG is top-notch and has world-class facilities. Food is okay. Medical facilities are available in college at some specific time. It has 2 boys mess. It also has games and sports in the building.

reviews.review_heading: My amazing college life at VJTI.
reviews.review_text: In my course, we have all facilities, such as Wi-Fi, a library, different labs for each subject, and classrooms equipped with air conditioning, projectors, etc. Talking about the hostel, there are 2 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel, which are old and have less space. Regarding the mess food, it is average, but we have special lunch on Sundays and non-veg on Fridays. As for the canteen, the food is good, but it is so small, and sometimes we don't even get a seat to sit and eat. Sports are promot...

reviews.review_heading: Good placement records, average infrastructure, and nice faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our infrastructure is average but the library is best. There are all the library facilities which are required for students. Also, there is free Wi-Fi in the campus area. The campus area is sixteen acres. There are two grounds. The infrastructure is nice.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement, good exposure, good teaching staff, and a student-friendly environment.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available across the campus, but it may not work in some areas. There are 2 hostels for boys and 1 PG hostel, which has very bad conditions for toilets and living rooms. But the PG is top-notch and has world-class facilities. The food is okay, and medical facilities are available in the college at specific times. There are 2 boys messes. There are games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with the level of teaching.
reviews.review_text: In the electrical engineering department, Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute has various research laboratories for research and study. Classrooms have all the required amenities like Wi-Fi, projector, smart screens, etc. The quality of the mess food is decent, and the fee for a hostel is affordable.

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure, small campus, decent teachers, average placements, and strong alumina network.
reviews.review_text: Fully furnished AC classrooms with Wi-Fi in each class are there. Infrastructure is decent. Labs are in bad condition with very old equipment. There is a huge library with many different books and Wi-Fi is available. Hostels are in very bad condition and four students in one room. There are no proper arrangements. Mess food is decent and non-veg is there only one day a week. Canteen has decent infrastructure and awesome food at an affordable price. Sports ground is there for cricket, football, b...

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Realistic review of B.A. LL.B. at Amity University Jaipur

review_content.Placements: The B.A LL.B. course in this university was one of the best among the universities of Jaipur. Amity University Jaipur was a very good college and gave many opportunities to students. Around 70% chance of getting placed in B.A. LL.B. As far as I knew, the highest placement in B.A. LL.B. was about 45 LPA, and recently it went up to 52 LPA, while the lowest package was around 4–5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities I got in my course and on the campus were very nice, including classrooms and hostels. There was a separate library for law students with 24/7 Wi-Fi. The hostels were very good. Facilities provided were also nice. There were three messes on campus and many food outlets where students enjoyed their food. Medical facilities were available 24/7, and all types of sports facilities were present where students could utilize their energy.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Applied Psychology (Honurs/ Research) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: My Amity University campus and academic review.

review_content.Placements: Amity generally gets good placement drive participation. Many big recruiters like Amazon, TCS, IBM, Capgemini, etc, visit campus, and for B.Tech 2025. The highest package is 35.9 LPA, while the average is 9.6 LPA, and the median is 6 LPA. That said, placement outcomes vary widely by course branch.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.

review_content.Placements: 90% placement students got placement in my course. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest being 4LPA, and the average was 5 LPA. Panacea Pharmaceuticals, Serum Institute, Biocon, etc, are some of the companies that actively recruit students from my course. 100% students got an internship from my course. The top role offered is an Associate Scientist.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Bioinformatics - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.

review_content.Placements: Actually, every senior from our college gets a placement. That is true, and the minimum LPA is about 5, which is good. At the beginning, companies like Deloitte and other companies, such as Omics, Logice, and Wipro, come for placement.
review_content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. in Film and Television Production - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Amity University rocks the stage.

review_content.Placements: 70% of students from my course get placements. The package offered in our course starts from a minimum of 30-40,000 to a maximum of 3-4 LPA. Top companies include T-Series, Zee Studios, Shemaroo, Netflix, and Amazon, etc. 30% of students get internships at Zee Studios. The top roles offered are DOP, editor, director, and copywriter, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Cyber Security - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: This is the best university for the M.Sc. in Cyber Security Course.

review_content.Placements: The average placement rate for this session and the previous one was 90% in the Cyber Security Course. The highest bid was 25 LPA. The average salary was around 15-20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are DevsData LLC, Nexus IT Group, Alta Associates, etc. Top roles offered are Chief Information Security Officer, Security Architect, etc. More students are getting their internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: University areas, labs, classrooms, sports fields, and cafeterias are all equipped with Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-equipped with the latest equipment, projectors, mics, and good AC. The food there is good, if not the best, in terms of taste and hygiene. Hostel rooms are spacious and have LAN and Wi-Fi. Initially, the cooling water caused a scarcity of drinking water, but now, slowly, the problem has been solved.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Jaipur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Applied Psychology (Honurs/ Research) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: My Amity University campus and academic review.

content.Placements: Amity generally gets good placement drive participation. Many big recruiters like Amazon, TCS, IBM, Capgemini, etc, visit campus, and for B.Tech 2025. The highest package is 35.9 LPA, while the average is 9.6 LPA, and the median is 6 LPA. That said, placement outcomes vary widely by course branch.
content.Infrastructure: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.

content.Placements: 90% placement students got placement in my course. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest being 4LPA, and the average was 5 LPA. Panacea Pharmaceuticals, Serum Institute, Biocon, etc, are some of the companies that actively recruit students from my course. 100% students got an internship from my course. The top role offered is an Associate Scientist.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Bioinformatics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.

content.Placements: Actually, every senior from our college gets a placement. That is true, and the minimum LPA is about 5, which is good. At the beginning, companies like Deloitte and other companies, such as Omics, Logice, and Wipro, come for placement.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in Film and Television Production - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Amity University rocks the stage.

content.Placements: 70% of students from my course get placements. The package offered in our course starts from a minimum of 30-40,000 to a maximum of 3-4 LPA. Top companies include T-Series, Zee Studios, Shemaroo, Netflix, and Amazon, etc. 30% of students get internships at Zee Studios. The top roles offered are DOP, editor, director, and copywriter, etc.
content.Infrastructure: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Cyber Security - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This is the best university for the M.Sc. in Cyber Security Course.

content.Placements: The average placement rate for this session and the previous one was 90% in the Cyber Security Course. The highest bid was 25 LPA. The average salary was around 15-20 LPA. Top recruiting companies are DevsData LLC, Nexus IT Group, Alta Associates, etc. Top roles offered are Chief Information Security Officer, Security Architect, etc. More students are getting their internships.
content.Infrastructure: University areas, labs, classrooms, sports fields, and cafeterias are all equipped with Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-equipped with the latest equipment, projectors, mics, and good AC. The food there is good, if not the best, in terms of taste and hygiene. Hostel rooms are spacious and have LAN and Wi-Fi. Initially, the cooling water caused a scarcity of drinking water, but now, slowly, the problem has been solved.

reviews.review_heading: My Amity University campus and academic review.
reviews.review_text: The campus generally offers modern classrooms, good labs and full campus-wide Wi-Fi, which supports academic excellence for technical professional courses. There are well-equipped laboratories and a large, well-stocked library. Hostels are separate for boys and girls, with options like single, double, and triple sharing. There is reasonably good infrastructure for core courses. Labs, library, classroom and campus facilities generally get positive marks in several reviews.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in Rajasthan for research studies.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at Amity University, Jaipur, are top-notch. The laboratories, classrooms, and daily amenities are all very good. The laboratories are all equipped with the latest research instruments, which are crucial for my course. The hostel facilities are very good, providing basic amenities needed for students. The food is also very good and affordable for students.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely worth every penny we are paying.
reviews.review_text: Everything is available, including Wi-Fi, labs worth 2-3 lakhs, classrooms with projectors, and a library worth visiting. I suggest everyone at least visit the campus, which provides a positive vibe and is worth every bit. There are several programs ongoing.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University rocks the stage.
reviews.review_text: We have a strong Wi-Fi connection, a folly studio, a recording studio, a computer lab, and well-cleaned, air-conditioned classrooms. We also have library support. The quality of the mess food was very good, and we have 24-hour medical support. We also have several sports and games available.

reviews.review_heading: This is the best university for the M.Sc. in Cyber Security Course.
reviews.review_text: University areas, labs, classrooms, sports fields, and cafeterias are all equipped with Wi-Fi. The labs and classrooms are well-equipped with the latest equipment, projectors, mics, and good AC. The food there is good, if not the best, in terms of taste and hygiene. Hostel rooms are spacious and have LAN and Wi-Fi. Initially, the cooling water caused a scarcity of drinking water, but now, slowly, the problem has been solved.

reviews.review_heading: Some faculty are good, and some are average.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average for now. Last semester, there were many instruments that were not available in the lab, and the classroom chairs were broken. Wi-Fi is good, medical facilities are also good, and at the university level, there are many sports clubs that a student can join.

reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure college in Jaipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very organized and beautifully blends with nature. The facilities are also good, like 5G Wi-Fi, lecture rooms with built-in projectors, and an excellent library that provides computers to students for study. Students just have to log in with their user ID.

reviews.review_heading: Have to think twice about the academic quality provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure provided by the department are so far good. The facilities include Wi-Fi access all over the campus, one student can only connect 2 devices to the Wi-Fi, and drinking water. Washrooms are available on every floor. Hostel facility is also good. Wardens are quite strict and discipline is mandatory. The quality of the food is also impressive. Amity provides different kinds of sports such as cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, etc. There is a clinic on the campus ...

reviews.review_heading: Till now, the experience is good.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good. We have proper labs, and there are separate labs for each language. To be honest, the hostel facilities are up to the mark, but the food quality is not up to the mark. So, you can avoid the mess food sometimes. We have multiple outlets, which also provide multiple food.

reviews.review_heading: This is an average college.
reviews.review_text: I would say the infrastructure here is average not too good but not shabby either. This college has a coupon system so don't fall for a cheap hostel fee, your money gets pretty drained here. The mess food is average too not good but not bad either except some days.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good and the best college.
reviews.review_text: Everything is going well here. Our faculty is friendly and approachable, and the departments have well-equipped labs. The hostels are clean, and the infrastructure of the buildings is very strong. The food quality in the mess and canteen is hygienic, and the medical facilities are excellent. Additionally, sports and games are prioritized and well-supported.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for B.Tech biotech.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are provided inside the hostel. Classrooms are also very nice. They have centralized air conditioning in the class. In hostel, they provide AC and non-AC rooms. Our hostel rooms are average in size. We have Nescafe inside the hostel and vending machines so that we can access snacks and food at night. Classrooms are big and they have projectors.

reviews.review_heading: Amity is a beautiful and sustainable campus.
reviews.review_text: My course provides well-rounded labs with major industrial machines like bioreactors (50L), freeze dryers, SEM, etc. The infrastructure of the building is good with Wi-Fi connectivity all over the campus. We have a government-sponsored project in my course too. Hostels are well-equipped with every necessity including Wi-Fi 24x7, water cooler, and laundry. We have different options for mess which students can choose according to their will. We have a dedicated medical emergency room for any kind ...

reviews.review_heading: Amity is humongous in terms of opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college campus is really good. The campus is humongous and astonishing. Our college has huge fields which are full of trees and greenery. It's quite peaceful and lovely to sit on the ground in the evening. Our course is really helping me a lot in understanding the subjects and maintaining my knowledge of the trends in the market. It will obviously help me in the future, as I will be up to date with the future market trends and placements.

reviews.review_heading: Good campus life and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good and well-equipped. There is a free Wi-Fi facility available throughout the whole college. The college is very vast covering 150 acres of land and is very well maintained. The college maintains a nature-loving vibe which helps us to stay connected with nature.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent college.

content.Placements: Our college placed atleast 98% of students. Majority placements occur in CSE and ECE branches. The highest package is 55 LPA this year, and average is 15 LPA. If we put little effort, we will be placed in the best company possible in the world.
content.Infrastructure: It provides best infrastructure in all over Bangalore with free campus Wi-Fi. Classrooms are equipped with AC. International-level food, with big mess is available. Medical facilities and sports are the best. If we are interested in cultural activities and sports activities, they have best facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It is a good academic institution with an awesome campus.

content.Placements: As I am studying in BMSCE college under the Computer Science Engineering course in our 2025 batch, more than 1000 students are studying in other courses. The highest package is nearly 50 LPA, the average is 8 LPA-10 LPA, and the lowest is 5 LPA. There are many top companies like PayPal, and many others. Here, a minimum of 70 percent of students get placed.
content.Infrastructure: As our college has excellent infrastructure, which gives a good Wi-Fi, and our course is CSE, which has many projects and other activities like coding and hackathons. Coming to the library, it is a heavenly place that I have experienced. Classrooms are also good. Here, sports are given more preference as our college sports trophies are displayed in the sports room, at the state, national, and international levels.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: BMSCE review -Why you should join this college?

content.Placements: Around 70 percent people get placed. 38 LPA is the highest, and 11 LPA is the average, which these college placements provide. Almost all the companies come, 60-70% people get internships in their 5th sem which is the 3rd year of engineering, SDE, and many other roles are offered, and it is worth it.
content.Infrastructure: The best hostels are here with good food and facilities. It is within the campus, and students enjoy their lives here. The hostel canteens are very good, and the very famous medical facilities are also good, as they have their own hospital nearby. Wi-Fi is good, and the labs are very advanced.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Industrial Engineering and Management - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I would say the college is average and decent, it's just very hyped up because of its reputation.

content.Placements: The placements in BMS College of Engineering are different for different branches. The highest package in 2025 was offered to the CSE technical branch, which was 50 LPA. For the IEM branch, the highest was around 12 LPA, and the average package was 8 LPA. Around 31 students in IEM got placed this year.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities you get are honestly average. The college has a huge reputation, but the campus is too small, and the main playground is small. The hostel and mess are decent. The buildings are well developed. But due to a lack of space, it's not easy to enjoy any event. It's okay, not too good, not too bad, but manageable. Just don't expect to have an elite feeling, hoping BMS College of Engineering is a top-tier 1 college. It's infrastructure is pretty decent.

reviews.review_heading: College is good, and students won't be disappointed in any of the aspects.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are proper. 24/7 Wi-Fi connection and labs for different purposes, which are helpful for research and development. Properly silent, good, and large library. Hostel quality is so good, the mess is clean, the canteen is clean, and it provides a variety. Medical facilities are also good, and sports and games are on top.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college.
reviews.review_text: It provides best infrastructure in all over Bangalore with free campus Wi-Fi. Classrooms are equipped with AC. International-level food, with big mess is available. Medical facilities and sports are the best. If we are interested in cultural activities and sports activities, they have best facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good academic institution with an awesome campus.
reviews.review_text: As our college has excellent infrastructure, which gives a good Wi-Fi, and our course is CSE, which has many projects and other activities like coding and hackathons. Coming to the library, it is a heavenly place that I have experienced. Classrooms are also good. Here, sports are given more preference as our college sports trophies are displayed in the sports room, at the state, national, and international levels.

reviews.review_heading: BMSCE review -Why you should join this college?
reviews.review_text: The best hostels are here with good food and facilities. It is within the campus, and students enjoy their lives here. The hostel canteens are very good, and the very famous medical facilities are also good, as they have their own hospital nearby. Wi-Fi is good, and the labs are very advanced.

reviews.review_heading: I would say the college is average and decent, it's just very hyped up because of its reputation.
reviews.review_text: The facilities you get are honestly average. The college has a huge reputation, but the campus is too small, and the main playground is small. The hostel and mess are decent. The buildings are well developed. But due to a lack of space, it's not easy to enjoy any event. It's okay, not too good, not too bad, but manageable. Just don't expect to have an elite feeling, hoping BMS College of Engineering is a top-tier 1 college. It's infrastructure is pretty decent.

reviews.review_heading: It is good. Facilities are average, clean, and games are good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are average. But we have to adjust while coming for food. They maintain the hostel clean. Games are good.

reviews.review_heading: It has popularity and fame only because of old college. The infrastructure is bad.
reviews.review_text: The college is smaller than some schools. The hostel infrastructure is old and poor. Some hostels are not even near the college, around 3-4 km away. They provide old buses for those students. Some hostels are small for the number of students, and the indoor facilities are also small.

reviews.review_heading: The college unfiltered B. MS C. E
reviews.review_text: B. MS College of Engineering is well known for its infrastructure and the area where it is situated. The campus is very good, and the hostels are also good. Mess food is top notch, classrooms are well-equipped with AC and projectors, and we have two libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Good Professors, small campus, but chill college.
reviews.review_text: Every basic facility is available, like any other college. Hostels are less in numbers, so many students live in PG. Sports and games facilities are decent. Most of the hostels are far from the college like 4-7 km. They do provide a bus facility. Mess food is good.

reviews.review_heading: BMSCE, an overview of the college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite bad, and they need to loosen up their pockets because the hostels, labs and classes could use a much-needed upgrade, and they do take a lot of fees, so it wouldn't hurt them to streamline some of that cash to the benefit of the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, our college is really very good for engineering placement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very nice, but its also not that easy to get into the hostels, especially for girls. We have only 5 hostels, but if u join a hostel, we also have extra activities and events going on in the hostel, which is extra fun apart from the college fest.

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant campus life with amazing events and energetic crowd.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is overall okay. The total area of our college is less than the engineering colleges supposed to have, the library facilities are really good, but they are not sufficient during internals and final exams, its usually crowded during that time.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good and has a good reputation as a college in Bengaluru.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my course, AI, ML, will include Wi-Fi available in the library. The labs are well-equipped, the equipment is also good, and the classrooms will have projectors and digital boards. The qualities of the facilities in the hostel are very good, and the food is also very good. Medical facilities are available every time there is a small ground available for sports, and there is a big ground in college.

reviews.review_heading: This is a very good college in Bangalore where anyone can join.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course include well-equipped lab. The classrooms will be digital, and there will be projectors also in classrooms. There is also Wi-Fi in the library for computers. There will be well-equipped library with books. The quality of facilities of hostel is very good, and the food will be same as in other colleges. There is a ground facility near the hostel to play games.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members need improvement, but the placements are good. Infrastructure is nice.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is strong, up to 300 Mbps, and labs have the latest fast-running computers, which are maintained properly. Classrooms are also neat and very helpful for concentration. The library is full of books that we can borrow. Hostel food is above average, and the dorm rooms are average. Medical and sports facilities are above average.

library.description:
The CMRIT Central Library, provides an ideal environment for intellectual inquiry with its multiple Study Spaces, Research Assistance, Reading, Learning and Instructional Resources.
The Central Library, with an area of 2400 sq.m, is designed in such a way it has natural light for the entire day and provides a friendly environment to gain knowledge in an effective manner. Accommodating various facilities such as reading-learning resources, Wi-Fi, Internet access, and electrical plug-in facilities, there are seating arrangements for about 200 users at any point in time.
Digital Learning Resources and online access to major e-Journals and e-Books on Science, Technology, and Management are available from VTU and Developing Library Network (DELNET). KOHA, an Integrated Library Management Software package is used for library operations and resource sharing among the CMR Group of Institutes’ libraries. 

Institutional Repository (IR), a digital repository of CMRIT Central Library Faculty publications provides access to major publications whilst allowing downloads.

Qualified, experienced, and well trained library professionals serve users at any point in time whilst offering assistance in meeting academic and research information needs.

reviews.review_heading: Review after 6 months in CMRIT, Bangalore. Exceed the expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is extremely beautiful, both interior and exterior. Wi-Fi is available as campus Wi-Fi. Labs are available for the subjects Python, C, Maths, Chemistry, and Physics in our department. There are also CAD labs. Classrooms have a conventional green board and a smart board. The library is extremely good, and most of my time goes there.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with decent placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The CSE department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a good library, and campus Wi-Fi, while the hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, average but hygienic mess food, basic medical support, and adequate sports and recreational facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A good college for students to choose in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: I stay in the hostel, so it is average in terms of Wi-Fi and food. But in college, it is quite good in terms of Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, and the library. Labs are properly set up. So there are not many setup or electricity issues. The library is a gem for anyone who wants to study at their own pace and learn a lot.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course and hostel is average. Classrooms have basic facilities. Sometimes lack proper maintenance and hygiene. Wi-Fi is provided on campus and in libraries. Hostel rooms are manageable, but cleanliness and water supply should be improved.

reviews.review_heading: From classroom to career- What CMRIT gets right.
reviews.review_text: The campus is medium-sized but well organized. Classrooms are smart-board enabled. The library is spacious with good digital resources. Labs, sports areas, the canteen, and study spaces are well maintained. Hostel availability is good, but food quality is average. Labs are well maintained and practical focused.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough to enjoy the college life.
reviews.review_text: Good Wi-Fi is available. Labs, trainers, classrooms, hygiene, and a peaceful library are present. In the hostel, hygiene and food are good. The mess is okay. Medical facilities, sports, and games are all available. The college trains students with skills to make them ready for the industry.

reviews.review_heading: An overview of my college in all fields.
reviews.review_text: I am a day scholar, so I don't have much idea about hostel facilities. But when it comes to classrooms, they have newly added smart boards in most of the classes. Wi-Fi is available in most places on the college campus. There is a stationery shop as well as a canteen for students with seating arrangements.

reviews.review_heading: Life of a CMR IT CSE student.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is really good. We have good Wi-Fi speed that goes up to 250 Mbps. All the computers are modern, and they have both Windows and Ubuntu operating systems to help students. Classrooms either have a smartboard or a projector. The food quality in the mess is good, the hostel also provides a good experience, but it is slightly costly, ranging from 1.4 lakh to 1.92 lakh. A sports room and gym are present with table tennis and other games.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with beautiful location
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good. It has all the necessary facilities. Classrooms are equipped with smart projectors and smart boards. All labs are also good with updated computers. The hostel is good but a bit expensive. The food is very decent.

reviews.review_heading: Prime location for IT placements with active student life, but the campus size is compact.
reviews.review_text: CMRIT College comes with a Wi-Fi-enabled campus and labs. Classrooms and libraries are well-maintained. Hostel food consists of a variety of items that are suitable for all residents. The campus also has a medical facility and supports participation in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of placement and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is okayish while labs are good. Classrooms don't have smart board and library is fine too. Wi-Fi in hostel is poor and there is no speed. There is no connectivity. Food is fine like I mean the usual price curry and idli dosa for breakfast. Canteen is fine too but some foods are overpriced. Sports facilities are good. There are cricket ground, basketball court, and tennis court too.

reviews.review_heading: Review on CMRIT as a First year student.
reviews.review_text: The CMRIT hostel is comfortable and convenient for the students to concentrate on their studies and campus life. The food quality is good, and mess hours are reasonable and well-coordinated so they do not interfere with class times. Safety is prioritized and considered an important factor for both students and parents. Plus, there are vending machines providing snacks and light refreshment which is very useful. On the whole, the hostel provides a decent, conducive environment for students living...

reviews.review_heading: Great college with top hackathon wings, supportive faculty, and excellent placements.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are huge and spacious. Every classroom in the college is equipped with a whiteboard and a smart board. I don't have enough words to express my gratitude towards the unwavering support given by the college, not only in academics but also sports and cultural. CMRIT takes a lot of care when it comes to students' health so the food served in canteen is thoroughly inspected and checked so that students are served hygienic and tasty food.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CMRIT from the first year's perspective.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure exceed expectations. The food quality is good. Sports grounds are also good. The hostel warden is strict and responsible. As one class of CS (AIML), the learning experience from our faculty is fairly good, and the Wi-Fi is good too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CMR Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: CMRIT has a modern and student-friendly campus that provides a good environment. The infrastructure is well developed. Most classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards. Large library with good seating capacity. The college has good canteen facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: It’s a decent college with good placements.

content.Placements: Placements were good at CVR College of Engineering. Companies like Oracle, Capgemini, and other service-based and product-based companies came to the college to hire. Generally, they hired for roles like data analyst, software developer, web developer, etc. This year, the highest package at our college is 72 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: In this college, we had facilities like AC labs, Wi-Fi-enabled campus, cricket ground, library, health center, sports complex, etc. The quality of these facilities was good, and the food in the hostel mess and canteen was also good, tasty, and hygienic. Every year, the college conducts EPL, which stands for Engineering Premier League.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college but overhyped.

content.Placements: Almost 90 percent of students from computer science and allied branches got placed. The average package is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Service Now, Salesforce, DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, and JP Morgan. 4-5 students from every class get an internship in the third year.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is average because it is old. But the equipment in the laboratories is good enough. I would say our college library is one of the best libraries. Coming to hostels, washrooms are combined floor to floor. The hostel and mess food are quite good in taste.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overhyped college, but decent.

content.Placements: Placements in this college are purely based on our academic scores. If any student has a backlog, then they are not eligible for some companies. Students who perform well in academics will definitely get placed in the campus interviews. The highest package offered last year was 51 LPA, and the average package was 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Each branch has separate labs and lab faculty members. There is only one library in this college, which is sufficient for students in each branch. It also contains different areas for different purposes, such as the internet, discussion room, etc. There is a canteen in this college which serves tasty and healthy food.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the top colleges in EAMCET.

content.Placements: In our branch, around 30-40 percent of students are placed in the college. The highest package in our branch is 10 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA. ITC and many other companies visited the campus. Overall placement may be around 12-20 percent. As a starting candidate, companies offer lower roles or entry-level roles.
content.Infrastructure: There are many good facilities in our college, like a gym and a proper ground. The food is very nice in both the hostel and the canteen. There are also good medical facilities. I loved the food more than the food prepared by my mom, as well as the canteen food.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Information Technology (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Decent college with decent placements.

content.Placements: Quite decent placements we have. But now many companies are not coming to our college. The highest package on paper is 60 LPA, the lowest is around 2 LPA, and the median is 5 LPA. Asian Paints, Qualcomm, Amazon, and Flipkart are the top recruiters for our college. I don't have much of an idea about the roles.
content.Infrastructure: We do have good facilities and infrastructure in our college, like everywhere you go, we have separate Wi-Fi for each floor in each block and spacious classrooms with digital projectors for interaction with students, and a big library, and we do have active club activities such as interactive sessions with professionals and experts.

The campus is clean and spacious with greenery. The hostel facility is satisfactory with average mess food but hygienic and there are sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It will be a great college, if given more freedom to students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty new in all the labs except for some labs, which have older computers. The Ethernet works fine but the Wi-Fi is slow. There is a large library with a wide selection of available books. The hostel is good, and the food provided is decent. We have a large cricket ground but it is not used very often. We have a small indoor sports area with table tennis tables. There is one basketball court and a place to play volleyball and football. A new Auditorium is being constructe...

reviews.review_heading: Not much worth for this huge amount of money.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is the worst ever. It is a nightmare. The food is eww, and we don't need to talk about it because it is a waste of time. Can't even go for a pleasurable wash time in the morning. It's the worst thing in the whole hostel combined, and the public toilets are too few in number.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good placements.
reviews.review_text: In this college, we have facilities like AC labs, Wi-Fi-enabled campus, cricket ground, library, health center, sports complex, etc. The quality of these facilities is good, and the food in the hostel mess and canteen is also good, tasty, and hygienic. Every year, the college conducts EPL, which stands for Engineering Premiere League.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities with balanced maintenance.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good compared to other colleges. Clean and hygienic with a comfortable environment, also maintained CCTV footage for security purposes. Mess food is also fine. We can eat. They prepare it very hygienically, and they provide chicken two times and eggs three times weekly.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if you are a sincere student.
reviews.review_text: CVR College of Engineering offers strong infrastructure with well-equipped classrooms, 100+ modern laboratories, and campus-wide Wi-Fi, along with a large, dedicated three-storey library that provides extensive physical and digital resources, including IEEE and other premium journals. The campus also includes a four-storey student centre with a gym, canteen, indoor games, placement office, and a medical centre, while sports facilities include cricket, basketball, volleyball, and indoor games; ho...

reviews.review_heading: Good college for placements, poor at events, and good at academics.
reviews.review_text: Labs are very good compared to all EAMCET colleges. Wi-Fi connections also work very well. Infrastructure is okay. The hostel infrastructure and food are very good, the infrastructure is very well manufactured. Canteen food is also good, similar to home food. There will be a sports period once a week, and we have a cricket ground almost equal to a stadium.

reviews.review_heading: The college is nature-friendly.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and comfortable. There are no Wi-Fi issues in the college, labs, and classrooms. The library is very spacious, and the quality of food in the hostel as well as the canteen is very good. Medical facilities are also good, but sports and games are limited.

reviews.review_heading: There is dissatisfaction because of the poor quality of the food.
reviews.review_text: There is a canteen, hostel, medical room, sports, class, and Wi-Fi for the CSE department. There is a hostel facility, but there is no quantity of food available in the mess, and no access to remaining facilities like a medical room, sports, a Class, a library, and games.

reviews.review_heading: A quality education means CVR College of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Sorry to say that I'm not a hosteler, but I can say about the infrastructure, which is quite good, like park, placements, sports, library, labs, equipment, classrooms, events, education, really it's loved by my heart. I think everyone loves it after joining.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my course.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good and peaceful. I noticed some lab assistants are teaching classes. Our hostel quality is best, the food rating is 4, and the canteen is best with all items always available.

reviews.review_heading: There are Strong placements and supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: There is a good facility, with Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, and a library. There is no issue with all these facilities, and the college hostel facility is also good. They maintain healthy food in the hostel and canteen as well, and medical, sports, and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good faculty, and the placement in 2024 is excellent, with a really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is above average, and the facilities are excellent, which are provided by the college. The library of our college is very good, and there are plenty of books to study and gain knowledge. The labs are pretty good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: We have good facilities in our college, and the faculty and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms with projectors, a huge library, nice hostel rooms with healthy and hygienic food, a canteen, a health center, etc. Faculty will be good. They will support us. We also have various clubs in our college, both cultural and related to academics.

reviews.review_heading: Quality learning  at CVR.
reviews.review_text: I am not staying at college hostel but I can say about the infrastructure which is quite good like park placements sports library labs equipment, classrooms events and education. Its really loved by my heart which is good.

college_info.intro:
Dayalbagh Educational Institute Agra, offers various courses to students at the UG and PG levels. The Institute also offers various Certificate and Diploma programmes to students across several specialisations. Candidates must complete the entire admission process of Dayalbagh Educational Institute (DEI) for admission to its offered courses. The admission process includes the application process, selection procedure, merit list, etc. Find below the DEI admission process 2025:
Step 1: DEI Application Process

Candidates must visit the DEI official website to fill out the application form before the last date using the submission of Common Application Form which is available on the Institute’s websitehttp://www.dei.ac.in. Candidates can opt for the offline application form as well which will be available at the Institute Counter.
Step 2: DEI Written Test

The institute conducts written tests for the eligible candidates. Candidates must make the selection of the Examination Centre from where the candidate will appear for all exams during the tenure of the programme. The DEI written test will last for two hours and based on the course curriculum.
Step 3: DEI Selection process

DEI selection procedure includes the candidate's performance in Written Objective tests conducted by Dayalbagh Educational Institute, and Interviews. Besides DEI’s entrance exam, the deemed university also accepts admission through national-level entrance exams such as JEE-Main, CUET, and NATA, among many others.
Step 4: DEI final selection
Once the candidates are selected are called for final admission. Candidates must pay the admission fee and secure their desired course seats at the Institution.

review_content.Placements: Many people in Maharashtra know about the placements offered by this college. Placements are offered in a good number, and almost 90-95% students are placed on campus. reviews_list.review_title: Good placements, supportive faculty, and a balanced campus life.

review_content.Placements: In my college, there are 70-80% of students placed. The highest package is 56 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and average package is 7 LPA - 8 LPA. Mass recruiters like Cognizant and many more are coming for placements and take the students in quantity, like 150-200 students.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a central library with a wide range of resources. Department provides access to project labs and seminar halls for presentations. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms and common areas. Mess food quality is satisfactory and hygienic, though canteen options are better. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports facilities include cricket, football, basketball courts, and indoor games. Overall, both academic and hostel infrastructure support a balanced student's life.

content.Placements: In my college, there are 70-80% of students placed. The highest package is 56 LPA, the lowest is 4 LPA, and average package is 7 LPA - 8 LPA. Mass recruiters like Cognizant and many more are coming for placements and take the students in quantity, like 150-200 students.
content.Infrastructure: College has good infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a central library with a wide range of resources. Department provides access to project labs and seminar halls for presentations. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms and common areas. Mess food quality is satisfactory and hygienic, though canteen options are better. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports facilities include cricket, football, basketball courts, and indoor games. Overall, both academic and hostel infrastructure support a balanced student's life.

DY Patil Institute of Technology's admission process begins with registration for the course. Candidates need to qualify entrance exam specific to their course, and appear for the counselling process for their respective programme. Below are the steps to follow to get admission to the DY Patil Institute of Technology:
STEP 1: DYPIT Pune Application Process 2025

Candidates need to fill out the application form for the entrance exam accepted for their programme. For BE, candidates must apply for MHT-CET or JEE Main for admission. Aspirants already with a valid score in the entrance exam must wait for the counselling registration.
STEP 2: Selection

Once the registration is over, candidates can appear for the entrance examination. Candidates who wish to apply for B.E. must score a valid MHT-CET or JEE Main score. The selection for MTech course is largely based on the scores of GATE. MBA aspirants can become eligible for admissions purpose based on their XAT, ATMA, etc or MAH MBA CET scores.
STEP 3: Merit List & Counselling

The counselling authority will release the MHT CET merit list for the BE programme. Candidates need to register for CET Counselling conducted by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra. While filling out the counselling registration form, aspirants need to provide their college and course preference. Selected aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.
